english: His legs are black because of being smeared with mud.
indonesian: Kakinya hitam karena diolesi lumpur.

balinese: Lengis uruté kapoles tekén mémé di bangkiangné.
english: The massage oil is smeared by the mother at her waist.
indonesian: Minyak urut itu dioles oleh ibu di pinggangnya.

balinese: Satondén matunu, bé siapé kapolésang aji basa lan kécap.
english: Before baking, the chicken meat is spread with seasoning and soy sauce.
indonesian: Sebelum dipanggang, daging ayam itu dioleskan bumbu dan kecap.

balinese: Batisné kapolpolin aji boréh apang tis.
english: His feet added with ‘param’ thickly to make it feel cool.
indonesian: Kakinya dilepa menggunakan param agar terasa sejuk.

balinese: Abianné kapondokin tekén bapa ulian tabiane sai palinga.
english: The garden was guarded by the father because the chili was often stolen.
indonesian: Kebun itu dijaga oleh ayah karena cabainya sering dicuri.

balinese: Seméné kapondong tekén buruhé ka toko.
english: The cement was carried by workers on their backs to the shop.
indonesian: Semen itu dipikul di atas punggung oleh pekerja ke toko.

balinese: Tunduné kapondongin baan bias akampil.
english: His back is loaded with a sack of sand.
indonesian: Punggungnya diberi beban sekarung pasir.

balinese: Jaman jani yén tusing kapongahang awaké, jog tusing maan apa.
english: Now if you don't dare and shameless, you won't get anything.
indonesian: Jaman sekarang jika tidak memberanikan diri, tidak akan mendapat apa.

balinese: Punyan pohé kapongkod tekén Ketut.
english: The mango tree was climbed by Ketut.
indonesian: Pohon mangga itu dipanjat oleh Ketut.

balinese: Ipun kapongor olih Ida santukan ipun misuna okan idané.
english: He was wrathed by him because he slandered his son.
indonesian: Dia dimurkai oleh beliau karena dia memfitnah anak beliau.

balinese: Kayuné kapongpong baan tetaniné .
english: The wood is made a hole by termites.
indonesian: Kayu itu dilubangi oleh rayap.

balinese: Tembok baléné kapongpongang abedik apang tusing ongkeb.
english: The wall of the building was made a little hole so as not to heat.
indonesian: Tembok bangunan itu dibuatkan sedikit lubang agar tidak panas.

balinese: Kursiné kapongpongin baan tetaniné kanti uug.
english: The chair was made into a hole by termites until it was destroyed.
indonesian: Kursi itu dilubangi oleh rayap hingga hancur.

balinese: Témbok punika kaporod olih ida rikalaning makta motor.
english: The wall was hit by him while riding a motorcycle.
indonesian: Tembok itu diserempet oleh beliau ketika mengendari motor.

balinese: Montor tiangé kaporodang tekén adin tiangé kanti usak.
english: My motorbike was crahsed by my brother until it was broken.
indonesian: Motor saya diserempetkan oleh adik saya hingga rusak.

balinese: Limané matatu ulian kaporot baan tali mangan.
english: His hand was injured because he was crushed with a sharp rope.
indonesian: Tangannya terluka karena digeret dengan tali tajam.

balinese: Bunga mawané kapotin tekén Putu.
english: The rose was planted in a pot by Putu.
indonesian: Bunga mawar itu ditanam pada pot oleh Putu.

balinese: Ulamé punika kapotong olih ida. Wusan mapotong, ulamé kagenahang ring kulkasé.
english: The meat was cut by him. After cutted, the meat is placed in the refrigerator.
indonesian: Daging itu dipotong oleh beliau. Setelah terpotong, daging itu diletakkan di dalam kulkas.

balinese: Ida mayoga ring gunung, kaprabain antuk sang surya nyantos sang candra rikala wengi.
english: He meditated on the mountain, illuminated by the sun until the moonlight at night.
indonesian: Beliau bertapa di gunung, disinari oleh sang surya hingga cahaya sang bulan di malam hari.

balinese: Taruné punika kapracala olih alit-alité.
english: The tree was shaken by the children.
indonesian: Pohon itu digoyang oleh anak-anak.

balinese: Kawéntenan peraturan daérah sané anyar puniki matetujon mangda basa Baliné nénten kapracampah.
english: The existence of this new regional regulation aims to prevent Balinese language from being underestimated.
indonesian: Keberadaan peraturan daerah yang baru ini bertujuan agar bahasa Bali tidak diremehkan/dipandang rendah.

balinese: Titiang kapracayain dados pangenter acara ring acara wanti warsa kota Denpasar.
english: I am trusted to be the host of the anniversary event of Denpasar city.
indonesian: Saya dipercayai menjadi pembawa acara di acara ulang tahun kota Denpasar.

balinese: Baos ipuné kapraceda olih anaké nika daweg parumané.
english: His words were reviled by that person during the meeting.
indonesian: Perkataannya dicerca oleh orang itu pada saat rapat.

balinese: Wenginé mangkin pacang sabeh. Punika kapraciriang antuk nénten wénten bintang sané mapraba ring langité.
english: It will rain tonight. It was marked by no star shining at the sky.
indonesian: Malam ini akan hujan. Itu ditandai dengan tidak ada bintang yang bersinar di langit.

balinese: Ukirané punika ngancan ngamecikang sesampuné kapradain.
english: The carving is getting better after being painted in gold.
indonesian: Ukiran itu semakin bagus setelah dicat emas.

balinese: Kawéntenan wangunan-wangunan ring pura Besakih punika kapradatayang olih kramané majeng ring torisé.
english: The existence of buildings in the temple of Besakih was explained by residents to tourists.
indonesian: Keberadaan bangunan-bangunan di pura Besakih itu dijelaskan oleh para warga kepada para turis.

balinese: Gaéné kapragatang tekén Wayan padidian.
english: The work was completed by Wayan alone.
indonesian: Pekerjaan itu diselesaikan oleh Wayan sendirian.

balinese: Buruh cariké kapraiang ulian ujané tusing endang-endang.
english: The workers in the fields were dismissed because the rain did not subside.
indonesian: Pekerja di sawah itu diliburkannya karena hujannya tidak reda-reda.

balinese: Sampiané suba kaprambat tekén Iluh. Jani punduhang lan wadahin aji plastik apang tusing daki.
english: Sampian (a sequence of young coconut leaves for offering ceremony) has been given a decoration by Iluh. Now collect and pack it with plastic so it doesn't get dirty.
indonesian: Sampian (rangkaian janur) itu sudah diberi hiasan oleh Iluh. Sekarang kumpulkan dan kemas dengan plastik agar tidak kotor.

balinese: Raksasané makasami kapranata olih Sang Anoman.
english: All giants were conquered by Hanoman.
indonesian: Semua raksasa ditaklukan oleh Sang Hanoman.

balinese: Malingé padem karejek olih krama desané.
english: The thief was attacked by villagers until death.
indonesian: Maling itu mati diserang oleh warga desa.

balinese: Kalender Baliné karéka olih Ketut Bambang Gde Rawi.
english: That Balinese calendar was written by Ketut Bambang Gde Rai.
indonesian: Kalender bali itu ditulis oleh Ketut Bambang Gde Rai.

balinese: Arca ring Pura Dalem karékaang pinaka Batara Siwa.
english: The statue in Pura Dalem is described as Lord Shiva.
indonesian: Arca di Pura Dalem digambarkan sebagai Dewa Siwa.

balinese: Kertas-kertasé ento kareketang aji lim kanji.
english: The paper is attached using glue made from tapioca flour.
indonesian: Kertas-kertas itu dilekatkan menggunakan lem berbahan tepung tapioka.

balinese: Tatune kareketin aji don binahong apang enggal uas.
english: The wound is attached to binahong leaves to get well soon.
indonesian: Lukanya dilekati daun binahong agar cepat sembuh.

balinese: Pikobetne setata karembag. Kanti kiap tiang ningehang.
english: The problem is always discussed verbally. I heard it until sleepy.
indonesian: Permasalahannya selalu dibicarakan dengan bertele-tele. Sampai mengantuk saya mendengarnya.

balinese: Upacara sané kalaksanayang malih kalih sasih, karembugang ring pura.
english: The ceremony, which was held in two months, was discussed at the temple.
indonesian: Upacara yang dilaksanakan dua bulan lagi, dirembukkan di pura.

balinese: Tutur reramané tusing karengaang. Disubané nemu sengkala, mara ia maselselan.
english: His parents' advice was not heard by him. After finding a disaster, he regretted it.
indonesian: Nasehat orang tuanya tidak dihiraukan. Setelah menemukan petaka, baru dia menyesal.

balinese: Satondén masang genténg, raabé karéngin malu.
english: Before installing tiles, the roof is first fitted with ‘reng’.
indonesian: Sebelum memasang genting, atap itu terlebih dahulu dipasangi reng.

balinese: Wangunan punika karentehang olih ida santukan pacang kawangun balé sané anyar.
english: The building was demolished by him because a new building would be built.
indonesian: Bangunan itu diruntuhkan oleh beliau karena akan dibangun bangunan yang baru.

balinese: Utangné karéntenang tekén bank.
english: His debt is levied by the bank.
indonesian: Hutangnya dibungakan oleh bank.

balinese: Ulam bawiné karepah olih ipun. Wusan punika kaaturang ring makasami krama sané rauh irika.
english: The pork was divided by him. After that it was given to all residents who came there.
indonesian: Daging babi itu dibagi-bagi olehnya. Setelah itu diberikan kepada semua warga yang datang di sana.

balinese: Ia nongos jumah sawiréh tusing buin ada karépotan. Gegaéné tuah pules dogén.
english: He stayed at home because there was no activity anymore. The job is just to sleep.
indonesian: Ia diam di rumah karena tidak ada kesibukan lagi. Kerjaannya hanya tidur saja.

balinese: Makejang timpal-timpalné karepotang tekén Madé. Nanging Madé tusing taén engsap tekén pitulung timpal-timpalné. Yéning mani puan timpalné ngidih tulung, ia nyadia nulungin.
english: All of his friends are troubled by Made. But Made never forgets the help of his friends. If tomorrow the friend asks for help, he is willing to help.
indonesian: Semua teman-temannya direpotkan oleh Made. Tetapi Made tidak pernah lupa dengan pertolongan teman-temannya. Jika besok lusa temannya meminta bantuan, dia bersedia membantu.

balinese: Sampun petang rahina okan idané nénten budal. Okané sampun karereh nyantos ka Jawi, sakewanten durung kapanggih.
english: It has been four days since he left home. His son has been searched to Java, but has not been found.
indonesian: Sudah empat hari anak beliau tidak pulang. Anaknya sudah dicari hingga ke Jawa, tetapi belum ditemukan.

balinese: Jantos dumun ajebos ratu, kantun karerehang kwaca olih Wayan.
english: Wait a minute, sir, Wayan is still looking for clothes.
indonesian: Tunggu dulu sebentar tuan, masih dicarikan baju oleh Wayan.

balinese: Saking dija ratu wawu ? Ratu karerehin olih rabiné.
english: Where had you been Sir ? You are sought after by your wife.
indonesian: Dari mana Tuanku tadi ? Tuan dicari-cari oleh istri tuan.

balinese: Montoré karérénang tekén polisiné ulian bas liu ngaba muatan.
english: The motorbike was stopped by the police for carrying too much cargo.
indonesian: Motor itu dihentikan oleh polisi karena terlalu banyak membawa muatan.

balinese: Acepok baang tutur, suba karesep baana.
english: Once given advice, he understood.
indonesian: Sekali diberi nasihat, dia sudah mengerti.

balinese: Munyin bapanne tusing karesepang teken Made. Ento mawinan ia salah tampi.
english: His father's words were not understood by Made. That caused him to misunderstand.
indonesian: Perkataan ayahnya tidak dipahami oleh Made. Itu menyebabkan dia salah paham.

balinese: Bale banjare sampun karesikin olih kramane makasami.
english: The Balai banjar (multipurpose hall) has been cleared by all residents.
indonesian: Balai banjar (balai serbaguna) itu sudah dibersihkan oleh semua warga.

balinese: Tiang ngelah panak telu. Ne pertama megae ring kapal. E…sane kedua kari masuk ring Satu Atap Pengiangan. Sane ketiga kari TK.
english: I have three children. The oldest work on a ship. Eehhh… The second one went to Satu Atap Pengiangan. The third one is still in kindergarten.
indonesian: Saya punya anak tiga. Yang pertama bekerja di kapal. E…yang kedua masih bersekolah di Satu Atap Pengiangan. Yang ketiga masih TK.

balinese: Ditu kone ada karicuan ulian liu anake tusing maan duman baas gratis uli pamrentah.
english: People said there was chaos because many people did not get a free portion of rice from the government.
indonesian: Di sana katanya ada kericuhan karena banyak orang yang tidak mendapat bagian beras gratis dari pemerintah.

balinese: Rahinane mangkin jagi wenten paruman indik karya sane pacang kalaksanayang ring pura. Bebaosan indik banten kariinang sadurung maosang indik dudonan upacara.
english: Today there will be a meeting regarding the ceremony to be held in the temple. Talks about "banten" or offerings take precedence before talking about the arrangement.
indonesian: Hari ini akan ada rapat mengenai upacara yang akan dilaksanakan di pura. Pembicaraan mengenai ‘banten’ atau persembahan didahulukan sebelum membicarakan mengenai susunan acara.

balinese: Mesehe sami sampun karimpung olih prajurit Idane ring payudan.
english: All enemies have been destroyed by his soldiers on the battlefield.
indonesian: Semua musuh sudah dibinasakan oleh prajurit beliau di medan perang.

balinese: Busunge karinggit teken meme apang ngenah renteb.
english: The coconut leaf is made into decoration shaped like jag by the mother to make it look festive.
indonesian: Janur itu dibuat hiasan seperti gerigi oleh ibu agar terlihat meriah.

balinese: Tikehe ento karingkes tur jaanga di tengah balene.
english: The mat is rolled up and placed in the room.
indonesian: Tikar itu digulung dan diletakkan di dalam ruangan.

balinese: Malingé karingkus tekén polisiné dugas nagih malaib ka Jawa.
english: The thief was arrested by the police when he wanted to go to Java.
indonesian: Maling itu diringkus oleh polisi saat ingin pergi ke Jawa.

balinese: Montor tamiuné karirigang di mukak umah tekén Pan Wayan.
english: The guest motorbike was lined up in front of the house by Mr. Wayan.
indonesian: Motor tamunya dileretkan di depan rumah oleh Pak Wayan.

balinese: Tuah amonto karirihan cainé ? Anak cerik mara lekad dogén mirib bisa !
english: Just that much of your intelligence? Just a newborn child might be able to do it!
indonesian: Hanya segitu saja kepandaianmu ? Anak kecil baru lahir saja mungkin bisa !

balinese: Pabianan tiangé karisakin tekén Pan Wayan miwah kurenanné sabilang wai.
english: My plantation is cleaned by Mr. Wayan and his wife every day.
indonesian: Perkebunan saya dibersihkan oleh Pak Wayan dan istrinya setiap hari.

balinese: Tiang stata nunas ica ring Ida Sang Hyang Widhi, apang icéna rahayu tur tusing karisebin tekén anak ané ngelah keneh jélé.
english: I always appeal to Ida Sang Hyang Widhi, to be given safety and not be bothered by people who have bad intentions.
indonesian: Saya selalu memohon kepada Ida Sang Hyang Widhi, agar diberi keselamatan dan tidak diganggu oleh orang yang mempunyai niat jahat.

balinese: Karma sané becik pacang ngametuang pala sané becik.
english: Good deeds will produce good result.
indonesian: Perbuatan yang baik akan menghasilkan perbuatan yang baik.

balinese: Upacara puniki pacang kalaksanayang ring sasih karo.
english: This ceremony will be held on the second month of the Bali calendar (August).
indonesian: Upacara ini akan dilaksanakan pada bulan kedua pada kalender Bali (Agustus).

balinese: Tiang ngaé tugas sekolah karoangin tekén Nyoman lan Ketut.
english: I made a school assignment assisted by Nyoman and Ketut.
indonesian: Saya membuat tugas sekolah dibantu oleh Nyoman dan Ketut.

balinese: Idupné karobedang tekén anak ane tusing demen tekén ia.
english: His life was troubled by people who didn't like him.
indonesian: Hidupnya disusahkan oleh orang yang tidak suka dengannya.

balinese: Mejané karodain apang aluh yen lakar ngisidang.
english: The table is fitted with wheels to make it easy if you want to move it.
indonesian: Meja itu dipasangi roda agar mudah jika ingin memindahkannya.

balinese: Liman tiangé karoges baan kukunné ane mangan.
english: My hands were clawed with sharp nails.
indonesian: Tangan saya dicakar dengan kukunya yang tajam.

balinese: Tiang menahin pagehan karombo tekén pisagan tiangé.
english: I repaired the fence helped by my neighbor.
indonesian: Saya memperbaiki pagar dibantu oleh tetangga saya.

balinese: Padiné telah usak uliang karongrong blabar dugas ujan bales dibi sanja.
english: All rice was damaged because it was flooded during heavy rains yesterday afternoon.
indonesian: Semua padi rusak karena dirongrong banjir ketika hujan lebat kemarin sore.

balinese: Bungan jepunné karosrosang tekén mémé di duur mejané.
english: The frangipani flower was scattered by the mother on the table.
indonesian: Bunga kamboja itu dicecerkan oleh ibu di atas meja.

balinese: Katik saténé karot tekén Bapa kanti alus.
english: The skewer was mashed up by the father until smooth.
indonesian: Tusukan sate itu diraut oleh ayah hingga halus.

balinese: Baléné ento karubuhang sawiréh bapa lakar nyumunin ngaé balé ané anyar.
english: The building was torn down because dad would rebuild the building by a new one.
indonesian: Bangunan itu dirobohkan karena ayah akan mengulang membuat bangunan yang baru.

balinese: Mobil tiangé karubuhin baan punyan kayu gédé di jalané.
english: My car was hit by a large wooden tree on the road.
indonesian: Mobil saya tertimpa pohon kayu besar di jalan.

balinese: Pan Wayan pedih ulian karudeg tekén panakné dugas megaé.
english: Pak Wayan was angry because he was disturbed by his son while working.
indonesian: Pak Wayan marah karena diganggu oleh anaknya ketika bekerja.

balinese: Gaé ané aluh ento karuetang tekén Wayan. Ia tusing nyak ngidih tulung tekén timpal-timpalné.
english: The easy work was made difficult by Wayan. He doesn't want to ask his friends for help.
indonesian: Pekerjaan yang mudah itu dibuat sulit oleh Wayan. Dia tidak mau meminta tolong kepada teman-temannya.

balinese: Jajan tiangé karugeh tekén Ketut. Tiang tuah maan jaja asibak.
english: My cake was forcibly requested by Ketut. I only got half a cake.
indonesian: Kue saya diminta dengan paksa oleh Ketut. Saya hanya mendapat kue separuh.

balinese: Yen liu anaké korupsi, sinah rakyaté ané karugiang.
english: If many people are corrupt, then the people will be harmed.
indonesian: Jika banyak orang yang korupsi, maka rakyatlah yang akan dirugikan.

balinese: Isin umahné karugrag dugas ngalihin bukuné ané ilang.
english: The contents of his house were dismantled when searching for his missing book.
indonesian: Isi rumahnya dibongkar ketika mencari bukunya yang hilang.

balinese: Pintuné ento karugragang aji linggis.
english: The door was dismantled using a crowbar.
indonesian: Pintu itu dibongkar menggunakan linggis.

balinese: Pohé ané alapa tekén Madé ento karujakang tekén timpal-timpalné.
english: The mango picked by Made was made ‘rujak’ (kind of fruit salad) by his friends.
indonesian: Mangga yang dipetik oleh Made itu dijadikan rujak oleh teman-temannya.

balinese: Kupingné karumbingin aji rumbing mawarna mas satondén mapoto.
english: His ears are fitted with a gold-colored 'rumbing' (ear stud that looks like a small snail) before taking a photo.
indonesian: Telinganya dipasangi dengan ‘rumbing’ (giwang yang bentuknya seperti siput kecil) berwarna emas sebelum berfoto.

balinese: Petakonné karumitang apang kéweh anaké nyaurin.
english: The question is made difficult so that people can't answer it.
indonesian: Pertanyaannya dibuat susah agar susah orang menjawabnya.

balinese: Murid-muridé karumpiukang di lapangané sawiréh ada pawarah uli bapak kepala sekolah.
english: The students were gathered in the field because there was an appeal from the principal.
indonesian: Murid-murid itu dikumpulkan di lapangan karena ada himbauan dari bapak kepala sekolah.

balinese: Dudonan acara ring pura punika karundingang olih krama desané ring wantilan.
english: The program in the temple was negotiated by the villagers at the multi-purpose hall.
indonesian: Susunan acara di pura itu dirundingkan oleh warga desa di balai serba guna.

balinese: Kawéntenan wantuan buku gratis saking pamréntah punika nénten karungu olih kramané, pamekasnyané alit-alité.
english: The existence of free books from the government is ignored by residents, especially children.
indonesian: Keberadaan bantuan buku gratis dari pemerintah itu tidak dihiraukan oleh warga khususnya anak-anak.

balinese: Sekat kalaina tekén Bapanné, I Ketut karunguang tekén dadongné.
english: Since left by his father, Si Ketut was cared for by his grandmother.
indonesian: Sejak ditinggal oleh ayahnya, Si Ketut dirawat oleh neneknya.

balinese: Lampu listrik sané kapertama karupaka olih Thomas Alva Edison duk warsa 1879.
english: The first electric light was created by Thomas Alva Edison in 1879.
indonesian: Lampu listrik yang pertama diciptakan oleh Thomas Alva Edison pada tahun 1879.

balinese: Pamulan kacang tiangé karurah baan beburonné.
english: My pea plants were damaged by animals.
indonesian: Tanaman kacang saya dirusak oleh binatang.

balinese: Dompét tiangé karurahin tekén anaké ento. Jani ia suba juka tekén polisiné.
english: My wallet was seized by that person. Now he has been arrested by the police.
indonesian: Dompet saya dirampas oleh orang itu. Sekarang ia sudah ditangkap oleh polisi.

balinese: Kurenan tiangé karuron. Uli dibi peteng tiang nongosin kurenan di rumah sakit.
english: My wife miscarried. Since last night I waited for my wife at the hospital.
indonesian: Istri saya keguguran. Sejak kemarin malam saya menunggu istri saya di rumah sakit.

balinese: Besiné ento karurusang tekén bapa aji linggis.
english: The iron is straightened by the father using a crowbar.
indonesian: Besi itu diluruskan oleh ayah menggunakan linggis.

balinese: Abian titiangé karusakang olih buron sané rusuh.
english: My garden was damaged by riotous animals.
indonesian: Kebun saya dirusak oleh binatang yang rusuh.

balinese: Dadi bisa keto, Beli? Musime jani sing karuan-karuan.
english: Why is that, Brother? Today’s weather is uncertain.
indonesian: Kok bisa begitu, Kak? Musim sekarang ini tidak menentu.

balinese: Eda bas ruet, unduké ené lakar kasaatang tekén bapan tiangé.
english: Don't be too frantic, this will be done by my father.
indonesian: Jangan terlalu kalut, urusan ini akan diusahakan oleh ayah saya.

balinese: Dugas ujan dibi sanja, panak tiangé kasaban ningehang munyin tatit.
english: When it was raining yesterday afternoon, my child was shocked and screamed at the sound of lightning.
indonesian: Ketika hujan kemarin sore, anak saya terkejut dan menjerit mendengar suara petir.

balinese: Wusan ngebah tiyingé punika, raris katabasin antuk parang olih I Gusti Rai.
english: After cutting down the bamboo, then flattened using machete by I Gusti Rai.
indonesian: Setelah menebang bambu itu, lalu diratakan dengan parang olih I Gusti Rai.

balinese: Eda ngéndah cai ngalawan rerama, katabianin nyen matan cainé apang nawang kapok!
english: Don't you behave brashly against your father, I'll give you chili on your eyes to deter you!
indonesian: Jangan kau berperilaku kurang ajar melawan ayahmu, kuberi cabai matamu biar jera!

balinese: Wangunan ento katabingin satonden karaabin.
english: The Building was fitted with a wall before fitted with a roof.
indonesian: Bangunan itu dipasangi dinding sebelum dipasangi atap.

balinese: Ring carita punika, akéh wanarané sané katadah olih raksasa.

indonesian: Tikar itu sudah semua digulung dan diletakkan di bawah meja.

balinese: Panakné Nyoman maringkus ulian ngadep narkoba.
english: Nyoman’s son was arrested for selling drugs.
indonesian: Anaknya Nyoman diringkus karena menjual narkoba.

balinese: Pan Wayan marirak mara orahina siep tekén kurenanné.
english: Mr. Wayan widened his eyes when told to be quiet by his wife.
indonesian: Pak Wayan membelalakkan mata ketika disuruh diam oleh istrinya.

balinese: Punyan nyuhé maririg uli kangin kanti kauh abianné.
english: The coconut tree is lined up from the east to the south of the garden.
indonesian: Pohon kelapa itu berjajar dari timur hingga selatan kebunnya.

balinese: Jukung-jukungé maririgan di pasisi pasih Sanur.
english: The canoe is lined up on the coast of Sanur.
indonesian: Sampan sampan itu berleretan di pesisir pantai Sanur.

balinese: Tiang maroang tekén Madé dugas maplalianan di sekolah.
english: I made friends with Made when playing at school.
indonesian: Saya berteman dengan Made ketika bermain di sekolah.

balinese: Ia maroban ajak nyaman-nyamane sawiréh ngelah paon tuah abesik.
english: He lives with one kitchen with his brothers because he only has one kitchen.
indonesian: Dia tinggal dengan satu dapur bersama saudara-saudaranya karena hanya memiliki satu dapur.

balinese: Jaman jani suba ada montor ané maroda telu.
english: Today there are three wheeled motors.
indonesian: Jaman sekarang sudah ada motor yang beroda tiga.

balinese: Ia tusing bani ngusud meong ulian taén marogés.
english: He did not dare to touch the cat because he had been scratched.
indonesian: Dia tidak berani menyentuh kucing karena pernah dicakar.

balinese: I Putu jegég pesan mapanganggo baju putih lan marok kuning.
english: Putu is very beautiful wearing white clothes and wearing a yellow skirt.
indonesian: Si Putu cantik sekali memakai baju putih dan menggunakan rok kuning.

balinese: Pekak tiangé enu dogén maroko kanti jani.
english: My grandfather is still smoking until now.
indonesian: Kakek saya masih saja merokok hingga sekarang.

balinese: Pepayasanné marombé-rombé buka penjor Galunganné.
english: Her makeup is exaggerated like penjor (bamboo decoration) on Galungan holiday.
indonesian: Riasannya berlebih-lebihan seperti penjor (hiasan bambu) pada saat hari raya Galungan.

balinese: Tebuné punika maron miwah mabantang mawarna ireng.
english: Sugarcane is black coloring leafy and has black stems.
indonesian: Tebu itu berdaun dan berbatang berwarna hitam.

balinese: Buah buluanné maroncé-roncé nanging tondén nasak.
english: The rambutan fruit is swaying but not yet mature.
indonesian: Buah rambutan itu bergayutan tetapi belum matang.

balinese: Umahné Madé maronda ulian ada orta yéning umahné lakar rampoka.
english: Made's house was guarded because there was news that his house would be robbed.
indonesian: Rumahnya Made dijaga karena ada kabar bahwa rumahnya akan dirampok.

balinese: Sanggah kemulanné marong tiga pinaka linggih Bhatara-Bhatari sané sampun kaupakarain.
english: The “Kemulanr" monument is a symbol of the place where the spirits of ancestors have been purified through religious ceremony.
indonesian: Tugu ‘kemulan’ beruang tiga sebagai simbol tempat roh para leluhur yang sudah diupacarai.

balinese: Lan pragatang gaéné bareng-bareng , eda maroang-roang apang énggal pragat.
english: Let's finish this work together, don't group so that it's finished quickly.
indonesian: Mari selesaikan pekerjaan ini bersama-sama, jangan berkelompok-kelompok agar cepat selesai.

balinese: Umah tiangé ajak umahné Madé marongan.
english: My house and Made’s house are made side by side.
indonesian: Rumah saya dan rumahnya Made berdampingan.

balinese: Abian badelod marongrong dugas ujan bales dibi sanja.
english: Gardens in the south were undermined when heavy rains yesterday afternoon.
indonesian: Kebun di selatan dirongrong ketika hujan lebat kemarin sore.

balinese: Muan tiangé maropeng ulian maplalian adeng tekén adin tiangé.
english: My face was smudged by playing charcoal with my sister.
indonesian: Wajah saya tercoreng-coreng karena bermain arang dengan adik saya.

balinese: Bangkiangné jani ruba maros ulian sai olahraga.
english: His waist is now slim because of exercising every day.
indonesian: Pinggangnya sekarang sudah ramping karena olahraga setiap hari.

balinese: Jagungé marosrosan uli karungé ané bolong ento.
english: The corn spilled from the holey sack.
indonesian: Jagungnya berceceran dari karung yang berlubang itu.

balinese: Katik saténé suba makejang marot. Nyanan lakar adepa tekén Bapa di peken.
english: The skewer was all mashed up. Later it will be sold by dad on the market.
indonesian: Tusukan satenya sudah semua diraut. Nanti akan dijual oleh ayah di pasar.

balinese: Tiang lan Wayan ngrincikang lakar nanem jagung di abian ané mara maruak dibi.
english: Wayan and I planned to plant corn in a garden that had just been cleared.
indonesian: Saya dan Wayan merencanakan akan menanam jagung di kebun yang baru saja dibuka lahannya.

balinese: Bibihné marué-rué suud ngalih coklat.
english: His lips are messy after eating chocolate.
indonesian: Bibirnya belepotan setelah memakan coklat.

balinese: Baléné badaja suba marugrag. Buin puan, ia lakar ngwangun balé anyar ditu.
english: The northern building has been demolished. The day after, he will build a new building there.
indonesian: Bangunan sebelah utara itu sudah dibongkar. Lusa, ia akan membangun bangunan baru di sana.

balinese: Panganggonné marugrugan di kamarné lan taén maumbah.
english: His clothes were in a bundle in his room and never washed.
indonesian: Pakaiannya beronggok-onggok di kamarnya dan tidak pernah dicuci.

balinese: Seneb tiang nolih cunguhné I Kocong maruing liu gati.
english: I was disgusted to see I Kocong's nose which contained a lot of dirt.
indonesian: Saya jijik melihat hidung Si Kocong yang berisi banyak sekali kotoran hidung.

balinese: I Wayan bagus gati mara bokné marujit.
english: Wayan is very handsome, his hair is short haircut..
indonesian: Si Wayan tampan sekali baru rambutnya bercukur pendek.

balinese: Ia maruket ajak timpal-timpalé di umahné Wayan.
english: He wrestled with his friends at Wayan's house.
indonesian: Dia bergumul bersama teman-temannya di rumahnya Wayan.

balinese: Truna-truniné maruket-ruketan mabalih konsér di lapanganné.
english: Young men struggle to watch concerts in the field.
indonesian: Pemuda-pemudi bergumul-gumulan menonton konser di lapangan.

balinese: Tanduk sampiné marumbing dugas milu makepung.
english: The cow's horn uses 'rumbing' (cow horn decoration) when participating in the ‘makepung’ (cart race with cow or buffalo) drawn by a pair of buffaloes or cows).
indonesian: Tanduk sapi itu memakai ‘rumbing’ (hiasan tanduk sapi) ketika mengikuti perlombaan ‘makepung’ (balap cikar yang ditarik oleh sepasang kerbau atau sapi).

balinese: Prajurité ento marumpi poléng lan ngaba bedil.
english: The soldier was wearing a camouflage vest and carrying a rifle.
indonesian: Prajurit itu memakai rompi loreng dan membawa senapan.

balinese: Wayan lan timpal-timpalné marumpiuk sambilanga ngrujak.
english: Wayan and his friends gather while making salad.
indonesian: Wayan dan teman-temannya berkumpul sambil membuat rujak.

balinese: Kramané marumpiuk-rumpiuk di wantilanné sawiréh bapak presidén lakar teka kema.
english: The residents gather at the multipurpose hall because the president's father will come there.
indonesian: Para warga berkumpul-kumpul di balai serbaguna karena bapak presiden akan datang ke sana.

balinese: Tusing liu krama ané teka marunding di pura.
english: Not many residents came to negotiate at the temple.
indonesian: Tidak banyak warga yang datang berunding di pura.

balinese: Cerik-ceriké marunduan mabalih wayang di pura.
english: The children flocked to watch the puppets in the temple.
indonesian: Anak-anak itu berbondong-bondong menonton wayang di pura.

balinese: Kramané marundungan pesu uli baléné ulian ada linuh.
english: Residents was flocked out of their house because of an earthquake.
indonesian: Warga berboyong-boyong keluar dari rumahnya karena ada gempa.

balinese: Sasihé jani, maruntun anaké ngantén sawiréh liu ada dewasa ayu.
english: Current month, successive people marry because there are many good days (according to Wariga's calculations).
indonesian: Bulan sekarang, beruntun orang yang menikah karena banyak terdapat hari baik (menurut perhitungan Wariga).

balinese: Suba a minggu maruntun-runtunan tiang maan surat uli anak tawah.
english: Already a week ago in a row I got a letter from an unknown person.
indonesian: Sudah seminggu beruntun-runtun saya mendapat surat dari orang yang tidak dikenal.

balinese: Sampun tigang dina sabehé maruntunan. Punika mawinan akéh genah sané keni gentuh.
english: It's been three days of continuous rain. That caused many places to be flooded.
indonesian: Sudah tiga hari hujan beruntun. Itu yang menyebabkan banyak tempat yang kena banjir.

balinese: Krama desané maruntut-runtutan ngranjing ka pura mangda trepti.
english: Villagers enter the temple in sequence to be orderly.
indonesian: Warga desa beriring-iringan memasuki pura supaya tertib.

balinese: Acara selanturnyané inggih punika motong tumpeng maruntutan antuk nembangang tembang rahajeng wanti warsa
english: The next event is cutting the rice cone accompanied by singing a happy birthday song.
indonesian: Acara selanjutnya yaitu memotong tumpeng disertai dengan menyanyikan lagu selamat ulang tahun.

balinese: Yen kanti buin marunyuh, tiang tusing ngidang buin ngulehang.
english: If you act inadvertently again, I can't help anymore.
indonesian: Jika sampai bertindak kurang hati-hati lagi, saya tidak bisa mengusahakan lagi.

balinese: Kruna kasusastraan meteges kawentenan ajah-ajahan utawi kaweruhan sane luih utawi becik tur mabuat. Manut ring pakayunan puniki wewatesan sastra Bali punika dadosné makasami tetamian pangweruh  sané marupa ajah-ajah, tatwa, susila miwah sané tiosan sané kasurat nganggé aksara Bali tur nganggén basa Bali sané katami rauh mangkin.
english: The word 'literature' means the existence of good or good teachings or knowledge. In accordance with this understanding the boundaries of Balinese literature are all knowledge inheritance in the form of teachings, philosophy, ethics and others written using Balinese script and using Balinese language which has been preserved until now.
indonesian: Kata ‘kesusastraan’ bermakna keberadaan ajaran atau pengetahuan yang baik atau bagus dan penting. Sesuai pengertian ini batasan sastra Bali adalah semua warisan pengetahuan yang berupa ajar-ajaran, filsafat, etika dan yang lainnya yang ditulis menggunakan aksara Bali dan menggunakan bahasa Bali yang disimpan hingga sekarang.

balinese: Raab pondok tiangé suba marurah dibi. Buin mani lakar nyumunin ngraabin aji séng.
english: The roof of my hut has been damaged. Tomorrow will reinstall the roof using zinc.
indonesian: Atap pondok saya sudah dirusak. Besok akan mengulang memasang atap menggunakan seng.

balinese: Mangkin sampun akéh wana sané sampun marusak. Pamréntah miwah krama makasami sepatutnyané stata ngupapira wana punika mangda lestari.
english: Now a lot of forests have been destroyed. The government and all citizens should always protect the forest to be sustainable.
indonesian: Sekarang sudah banyak hutan yang sudah dirusak. Pemerintah dan warga semua seharusnya selalu menjaga hutan itu agar lestari.

balinese: Yén suba makita dadi jayanti, yadiastun masaat-saatang ngajak timpal tusing ja buungan.
english: If you want to be a champion, competing with friends is inevitable.
indonesian: Jika sudah berkeinginan menjadi juara, bersaing dengan teman pun tidak terhindarkan.

balinese: Sarahina Ibu maan gae ngajang kayu, Bu? Nggih, polih ja nyeng….yen masan repot tiang ten, masan rerainan.
indonesian: Setiap hari Ibu dapat pekerjaan mengangkat kayu, Bu? Ya, dapatlah sekitar….kalau saat sedang sibuk saya tidak, saat hari raya (misalnya).

balinese: Carang punyan nyambuné masepak tatelu.
english: The guava tree branch has three branches.
indonesian: Ranting pohon jambu itu bercabang tiga.

balinese: Yen dadong kan keturunan Majapahit masih.
english: Grandma also Majapahit descendant.
indonesian: Nenek kan keturunan Majapahit juga.

balinese: Punapi carane yening iraga lakar masemadi, Kak? Sari, dadi masila.
english: How do we meditate, Grandpa? Sari, you can sit in a cross legged position.
indonesian: Bagaimana caranya bila kita hendak bersemadi, Kek? Sari, bisa dengan duduk bersila.

balinese: Punyan timuné masulur lantang gati.
indonesian: Pohon timun itu memiliki sulur yang sangat panjang

balinese: Suud madaar tiang mataag nyihnayang basange suba warég.
english: After eating, I belch, indicating that the stomach is full.
indonesian: Setelah makan saya berserdawa menandakan bahwa perut sudah kenyang.

balinese: Dadong tiangé mataanan labuh kanti limané lung, ulian ia nyelélés di ampiké ané belig.
english: My grandmother suffered a fall until her hand broke, because she slipped on a slippery floor.
indonesian: Nenek saya menderita terjatuh hingga tanganya patah, karena ia terpleset di lantai yang licin.

balinese: Yen suba di sasih kapaté, bunga-bungané mekar lan mataasan ulung di rurungé.
english: If it’s ‘sasih kapat’ (fourth month around in October or also called ‘sasih kartika’), the flowers bloom and fall fall on the streets.
indonesian: Jika sudah di 'sasih kapat' (bulan keempat sekitar di bulan oktober atau disebut juga dengan ‘sasih kartika’), bunga-bunganya mekar dan berguguran jatuh di jalanan.

balinese: Punika wit-witan pisang duwen I Ratu sampun matabas, sané sadurungné ka alap buahnyané antuk Bapan Titiangé.
english: Ratu’s banana trees have been flattened, which had harvested by my father earlier.
indonesian: Pohon-pohon pisang milik Ratu itu sudah diratakan, yang sebelumnya di panen buahnya oleh bapak saya.

balinese: Layangan kertasé matabeh aji lem apang kuat neket di bantangné.
english: The paper kite uses a glue reinforcement to stick it to the frame.
indonesian: Layangan kertas itu menggunakan penguat lem agar merekat di kerangkanya.

balinese: Kubuné ento suba matabeng aji somi, sinah tusing lakar tampyasan yeh ujan.
english: The hut has been using straw protective cover, so it will not be exposed to rainwater.
indonesian: Gubuk itu sudah berpengaling jerami, maka tidak akan terpapar air hujan.

balinese: Eméh aéng lalah rujakné ulian matabia lelima.
english: Wow, this salad is so spicy because it has five seeds of chili.
indonesian: Waduh, pedas sekali rujak ini karena bercabai lima biji.

balinese: Dokare ento matabih papat.
english: horse carriage contains four wheels.
indonesian: Delman itu berisi empat roda.

balinese: Awai bisa pang lima ia madaar. Ento mawinan basangne matabih-tabih.
english: In a day he can eat five times. That is why his stomach folds (because of fat).
indonesian: Sehari dia bisa makan lima kali. Itu sebabnya perutnya berlipat-lipat (karena gemuk).

balinese: Warungne Wayan matabing aji triplek.
english: Wayan stalls walled with plywood.
indonesian: Warungnya Wayan berdinding triplek.

balinese: Tuni tiang nolih ada mobil matabrakan di pengkolane.
english: Laterly I see there was a car collide on.
indonesian: Tadi saya melihat ada mobil bertabrakan di tikungan.

balinese: Anaké ento matadah dueg dogén, makejang anaké tusing guguna.
english: That person just acted smart, everyone ignored him.
indonesian: Orang itu berlagak pintar saja, semua orang tidak dihiraukannya.

balinese: Dugas tiang melali ka Nusa Dua, jaja lan pipis bekel suba matadongan.
english: When I went to Nusa Dua, snacks and pocket money were available.
indonesian: Ketika saya jalan-jalan ke Nusa Dua, jajan dan uang saku sudah tersedia.

balinese: Murid-muridé matadtadan majalan ka sekolah.
english: The students bring something by carrying it to school.
indonesian: Murid-murid itu membawa sesuatu dengan menenteng berjalan ke sekolah.

balinese: Sekat liu ngelah pipis paonné Wayan stata mataga.
english: Since he has a lot of money, Wayan's kitchen is always available for food or drinks excessively.
indonesian: Sejak banyak punya uang, dapurnya Wayan selalu tersedia makanan atau minuman secara berlebihan.

balinese: Dugas malali ka Bedugul, tas mémén tiangé mataga-taga.
english: When going to Bedugul, my mother's bag always provided excessive food or drinks.
indonesian: Ketika jalan-jalan ke Bedugul, tas ibu saya selalu tersedia makanan atau minuman yang berlebihan.

balinese: Rincikné Wayan suba matebag. Ia tusing ngidang mogbogin tiang.
english: Wayan’s plan had been guessed. He can't lie to me.
indonesian: Rencananya Wayan sudah tertebak. Dia tidak bisa membohongi saya.

balinese: Baang tiang galah anggon matebah, yén suba ada putusan, tiang lakar mai buin.
english: Give me time to consider, if there is a decision, I will come here again.
indonesian: Beri saya waktu untuk mempertimbangkan, jika sudah ada keputusan, saya akan ke sini lagi.

balinese: Bangket sané makantah sampun matebas.
english: The pawned rice fields have been redeemed.
indonesian: Sawah yang tergadai sudah ditebus.

balinese: Rahajeng semeng, ibu. (Why are you here and what are you doing?) Tiang mriki matulung {karena} wenten gae nak kar nganten. Tiang driki matulung majaitan lan matanding. Suksma. Suksma mewali.
english: Good morning, madam. Why are you here and what are you doing? I am here to help {because -Indonesian} there is a task to do for people who are getting married. I am here to help making little offerings and decorations and putting together the offering baskets. Thank you. You are welcome.
indonesian: Selamat pagi, Ibu. (Mengapa Anda di sini dan apa yang sedang Anda lakukan?) Saya di sini membantu (karena) akan ada upacara perkawinan. Saya di sini membantu membuat perlengkapan upacara dari janur dan menyiapkannya. Terima kasih. Terima kasih kembali.

balinese: Tiang mabanjar di Selat Tengah, Susut, Bangli.
english: I'm a part of the Selat Tengah, Susut, Bangli community.
indonesian: Saya bagian dari komunitas Selat Tengah, Susut, Bangli.

balinese: Ia meinpus ulian gelem.
english: He used an IV because he was sick.
indonesian: Ia memakai infus karena menderita sakit.

balinese: Oh nggih, durusang. Tiang jagi ngorahin restoranne nyiapin meja angge sareng kalih.
english: Oh yes, please. I will inform the restaurant to prepare a table for two.
indonesian: Oh iya, silakan. Saya akan memberitahukan pihak restorannya menyiapkan meja untuk dua orang.

balinese: Ia mejan anggon menék.
english: He uses stairs to go up.
indonesian: Ia mempergunakan tangga untuk naik.

balinese: Ia demen mejas.
english: He likes to wear a suit.
indonesian: Ia suka memakai jas.

balinese: Ia negak mejoh-johan.
english: He sat far and wide.
indonesian: Ia duduk berjauh-jauhan.

balinese: Panak bebek madan memeri.
english: A baby duck is called a duckling.
indonesian: Anak bebek disebut 'memeri'.

balinese: Nggih, wenten nika ring merajan tiange. Dados tiang nyelang tur malajahin babade punika, Beli?
english: Yes, I have it at my family shrine. May I borrow and learn those Babad?
indonesian: Iya, ada di merajan saya. Boleh saya pinjam dan pelajari sejarah tersebut, Kak?

balinese: titiang mesare di kamar
english: i am sleeping in the bedroom
indonesian: saya tidur di kamar

balinese: Iriki mesin pengolah coklate taler kabersihin nganggen yeh coklat. Nah, sisane punika sane kaolah.
english: The machine that processes the chocolate here can be cleaned with chocolate water. So, those remains are recycled.
indonesian: Di sini mesin pengolah coklatnya juga dibersihkan menggunakan air coklat. Nah, sisanya itu yang diolah.

english: Counting leaves for one of the necessities for a ceremony.

balinese: Mangkin meweh ngrereh bahan makanan sane alami.
english: Nowadays it is difficult to find organic foods.
indonesian: Sekarang susah mencari bahan makanan yang alami.

balinese: Dane jero bendesa midartayang indik dudonan karya ring pura
english: The village head explains about the ceremony arrangement at temple
indonesian: Kepala desa adat menjelaskan tentang susunan acara di pura

balinese: Tiang tuni midenin mesin montore satonden luas
english: I just checked the motorcycle's machine before I go
indonesian: Saya tadi mencoba mesin motor itu sebelum pergi

balinese: Bapa midpidin uritan padine aji tiing
english: Father is installing fence for rice nursery with bamboo
indonesian: Ayah memagari persemaian padi itu dengan bambu

balinese: Beli tusing dadi mierin dewek tiange !
english: You can not curb me brother !
indonesian: Kakak tidak boleh mengekang diri saya !

balinese: Prajuru desane migumang indik kawentenan wantuan saking pemerintah pusat.
english: The village apparatus discussed about the existence of assistance from the central government.
indonesian: Perangkat desa merundingkan tentang bantuan dari pemerintah pusat.

balinese: Ngiring sareng - sareng migunaang piranti bekas kanggen piranti sane maguna
english: Let's use secondhand things to make a usefull things together
indonesian: Ayo bersama - sama memanfaatkan barang bekas menjadi barang yang berguna

balinese: Ipun migung jinah sesampune wusan madolan ring pasar.
english: He count the money after finished selling at market.
indonesian: Dia menjumlahkan uang setelah selesai berjualan di pasar.

balinese: Tiang tusing miidin musuh.
english: I am not afraid of enemy.
indonesian: Saya tidak takut dengan musuh.

balinese: Ia miitang raga dugasé malajah nuju ujian sekolahé.
english: He confine himself so as not to be disturbed by people when he studied for the school exam.
indonesian: Dia mengurung dirinya agar tidak diganggu orang ketika belajar untuk ujian sekolah.

balinese: Ia miler kuping panakne.
english: He twist his child's ear.
indonesian: Dia menjewer telinga anaknya.

balinese: Wayan miles besine ento.
english: Wayan bend the iron.
indonesian: Wayan membengkokkan besi itu.

balinese: Meme milihang tiang baju.
english: Mother choose clothes for me.
indonesian: Ibu memilihkan baju untuk saya.

balinese: Ooh… luung. Kan dueg tiang milihin.
english: Ooh… good. I’m smart at choosing.
indonesian: Ooh… bagus. Pintar kan saya memilihnya.

balinese: Bapa miling don jagung anggona roko.
english: Father rolls the corn leaf to make cigarettes.
indonesian: Ayah menggulung daun jagung untuk rokok.

balinese: Lipine milit liman tiange.
english: The snake wrap my hand.
indonesian: Ular itu melilit tangan saya.

balinese: Meme milpil prabote di paon.
english: Mother arranges furniture in the kitchen.
indonesian: Ibu menata perabotan di dapur.

balinese: Paané mimpek.
english: His thighs are pinched.
indonesian: Pahanya tercubit.

balinese: Ia negakin sepéda sambilanga nadtadang térmos di limané ané kiwa.
english: He rode a bicycle while carrying a thermos in his left hand.
indonesian: Dia mengendarai sepeda sambil menentengkan termos di tangan kirinya.

balinese: Tiang tusing naen ia lakar teka mai.
english: I didn't think he would come here.
indonesian: Saya tidak mengira ia akan datang kemari.

balinese: Tumben Luh Ayu teka ka umahné Wayan. Prajani Wayan naganin jaja lan minuman ané jaen.
english: Luh Ayu came to Wayan’s house for the first time. Instantly Wayan provided snacks and good drinks.
indonesian: Luh Ayu tumben datang ke rumahnya Wayan. Seketika Wayan menyediakan jajan dan minuman yang enak.

balinese: Ampun sue Pak ngambil karya… ngolah kayu niki? A..wenten nyeng lima taunan niki. O kenten. Yen sadurung nika…napi.. ne ambil Pak karyane? Ah..tiang nak sistem..sistem buruh niki. Nak gado-gado. Napi gen jeg…jeg (je)mak tiang.
indonesian: Sudah lama Pak mengambil pekerjaan… mengolah kayu ini? A..ada sekitar lima tahunan ini. O begitu. Kalau sebelum itu…apa.. pekerjaan yang,Pak, ambil? Ah..saya orangnya sistem..sistem buruh ini. Orang campur-campur. Apa saja spontan saya ambil.

balinese: Sing taen ia mulih ka umah reramane. Kacrita jani Ni Kesuna kone nepukin mbokne, mapanganggo melah-melah. Laut ia nakonang uli dija maan panganggo buka keto.
english: She never went back to her parent’s place. It was said that one day Ni Kesuna met her sister by chance, in her splendid attire. So she asked her where did she get all those from.
indonesian: Ia tidak pernah pulang ke rumah orang tuanya. Konon diceritakan sekarang Ni Kesuna berjumpa kakaknya, berpakaian bagus-bagus. Lantas ia bertanya dari mana mendapatkan pakaian seperti itu.

balinese: Lurus manten, Pak, drika. Kira-kira wenten malih limang kilone nampek ampun drika Pura Bature, kenten.
english: Go straight ahead, Sir, over there. Around five kilometers more and Batur Temple is very near from there.
indonesian: Lurus saja, Pak, di sana. Kira-kira ada lagi lima kilonya sudah dekat di sana Pura Batur, begitu.

balinese: Nika nampek, kok, saking drika.
english: It's already close to here.
indonesian: Itu dekat, kok, dari sana.

balinese: Napi gen e..masalahne yen Pak mamula padi totonan? Yen musim panes..payah ampun tiang. Musim ujan, malih payah, ten mrasidayang nandur musim ujan.
english: What are the problems of planting rice, Sir? In the hot season, I've already worked. In the rainy season, its more work, you can't afford to plant in the rain.
indonesian: Apa saja e..masalahnya kalau Pak menanam padi itu? Kalau musim panas..payah sudah saya. Musim hujan, lebih payah, tidak mampu menanam (saat) musim ujan.

balinese: Baanga pipis satus nanggu satus tigang benang.
english: Was paid a hundred and a hundred seventy five more.
indonesian: Diberi uang seratus lebih seratus tujuh puluh lima.

balinese: Titiang taru nangka, daging nyem, akah nyem, engket putih, babakan titiang dumalada. Titiang dados anggen tamba ngenyeb. Ambil don titiang sane nguda tigang besik, raris kacampur mica solas besik, kaurap ring uluati.
english: I am the Jackfruit tree. The content of the substances is cold, the sap is white, the bark of my stem is medium. I can be used as a medicine for nausea. Take three pieces of the leaves and mixed with eleven pepper, then applied as topical ('uwap') to the pit of the stomach.
indonesian: Saya pohon nangka, kandungan zatnya dingin, getah putih, kulit batang saya sedang. Saya dapat digunakan sebagai obat mual. Ambil daun yang muda tiga lembar dicampur merica sebelas biji, ditempelkan pada bagian ulu hati.

balinese: Malih pidan Beli lakar nangkil muspa ring Pura Kawitane? Boya ke benjang jagi wenten odalan?
english: When do you plan to pray at the ancestor temple ? Will there be a ceremony tomorrow?
indonesian: Kapan Kakak akan datang bersembahyang ke Pura Kawitan? Bukankah besok akan ada perayaan?

balinese: Om Swastiastu. Nawegang, dados tiang mataken? Om Swastiastu. Nggih, rarisang, napi jagi takenang?
english: Peace be with you. Pardon, may I ask a question? Peace be with you. Yes, go ahead, what would you like to ask?
indonesian: Om Swastiastu. Permisi, boleh saya bertanya? Om swastiastu. Silakan, apa yang mau ditanyakan?

balinese: Dadi tiang mlajah napinin malu, mbok ? Dadi dogen, Luh.
english: May I learn how to separate the seeds, sister? Of course you may learn, Luh.
indonesian: Boleh saya belajar menampi dulu, Kak? Boleh saja, Luh.

balinese: Niki mawasta Nasi Yasa, madaging saur, janganan kacang panjang, taluh, gerang, udang, ulam ayam sareng terong..tuung..tuung. Suksma.
english: This is called 'Nasi Yasa', containing fried grated coconut, long bean vegetable, egg, anchovy, shrimp, chicken and eggplant. Thank you.
indonesian: Ini disebut 'Nasi Yasa', berisi kelapa parut goreng, sayur kacang panjang, telur, ikan teri, udang, ikan dan terong. Terimakasih.

balinese: Nyampatin natah
english: Sweep out the yard
indonesian: Menyapu halaman

balinese: Mih, selae tali? Aeng pesan Sekar nawah ne.
english: What, twenty five thousand? You’re bargaining too much.
indonesian: Ya, ampun, dua puluh lima ribu? Terlalu sekali Sekar menawar.

balinese: Kenken dogen carane anak manyi ento, Mbok ?
english: How does the harvesting work, sister?
indonesian: Apa saja tahapnya orang memanen padi itu, Kak?

balinese: Kan wenten pertigaan ke Bangli taler nika ne ke kanan.
english: Yeah, there's a a fork to Bangli also that's to the right.
indonesian: Kan ada pertigaan ke Bangli juga itu yang ke kanan.

balinese: Bapa dueg gati nebag cecimpedanné i mémé.
english: Father is very clever at guessing mother’s riddle.
indonesian: Ayah pintar sekali menebak teka-tekinya ibu.

balinese: Tusing dadi nebah yening ngraos teken anak lingsir.
english: It is not permissible to use normal language when talking to parents (respected people).
indonesian: Tidak boleh menggunakan bahasa lumrah jika berbicara dengan orang tua (orang yang dihormati).

balinese: Aji nebas karang punika anggéna ngwangun sekolah.
english: Father bought the land to build a school.
indonesian: Ayah membeli tanah itu untuk membangun sekolah.

balinese: Daweg montor titiangé kaambil, ida sané nebasang montor titiangé.
english: When my motorcycle was taken, he redeemed my motorbike.
indonesian: Ketika motor saya diambil, beliau yang menebus motor saya.

balinese: Tiang negak ring sisi manten, jagi nyingakin segarane sane becik driki.
english: I would like to sit outside. I can enjoy the beautiful scenery.
indonesian: Saya duduk di luar saja, hendak melihat pantainya di sini yang indah.

balinese: Ipun waged pisan nembang pupuh sinom.
english: He is very good at singing sinom poetry.
indonesian: Dia piawai sekali menyanyikan pupuh sinom.

balinese: Ring sang sane nembenin, wenten asana ngupamiang rupan gunung (parvatasana), asana ring baong (greeva sanchalana), ring bahu (kandra chakra), asana cobra ( bujanggasana), miwah gerakan sane lianan.
english: As a beginner, there is a posture that looks like a mountain, a posture of the neck, a posture of the shoulder, a cobra posture, and others postures as well.
indonesian: Bagi yang baru pertama kali melakukannya, ada asana yang mengumpamakan rupa gunung (parvatasana), asana di leher (greeva sanchalana), di bahu (kandra chakra), asana cobra (bujanggasana), dan gerakan yang lainnya.

balinese: Ento mawanan Meme lan Bapan Luhe ngajak malukat, apang I Luh nemu kasukan lan padewekan nirmala.
english: Therefore your mother and father urge you to perform purification, so that you will achieve happiness and a peaceful soul.
indonesian: Itulah alasan Ibu dan Bapak I Luh mengajak malukat, agar I Luh memperoleh kebahagiaan dan kesucian diri.

balinese: Gus, e..yen tiang uli Banjar Selat Tengah nenenan kel ke Pura Tirta Empul, dija ambahin tiang, Gus?
english: Bro, eh, if I want to go from this Selat Tengah Banjar to Tirta Empul Temple, which way do I go, bro?
indonesian: Gus, e..kalau saya dari Banjar Selat Tengah ini mau ke Pura Tirta Empul, lewat mana saya, Gus?

balinese: Makejang matunu be pasihe? Nenten nika, wenten shusi lan ulam segara sane kalablab.
english: Are all the fish grilled? Not all, we offer sushi and steamed fish too.
indonesian: Apakah semua dipanggang menu ikan lautnya? Tidak, ada shusi dan ikan laut yang direbus.

balinese: Aa…sekitar seket meter ling driki, Pak, Pak, nepukin pertigaan kaja kauh.
english: Yes, about 50 meters from here, sir, sir, you can see a fork in the northwest.
indonesian: Aa…sekitar lima puluh meter dari sini, Pak, Pak, melihat pertigaan utara barat.

balinese: Yadiastun cenikan I Made Rai malunan maan jodoh tekening beline. Suud ento mara beline nganten. Cara panglingsire ngorahang, buka makedengan ngad.
english: Even I Made Rai is younger, he got married first, then, his older brother got married later. The elders said, just like pulling a knife which is made of bamboo.
indonesian: Walaupun lebih muda, Made Rai lebih dulu mendapatkan jodoh daripada kakaknya. Sesudah itu baru kakaknya menikah. Sebagaimana kata tetua, seperti menarik sembilu.

balinese: Suba ngaba ngiu mai? Suba, I meme mara ngemaang.
english: Have you bring the tray along with you? Yes, my mom just gave it to me.
indonesian: Sudah membawa nyiru kemari? Sudah, Ibu barusan memberikan.

balinese: Tiang ngae klakat. Suksma. Kenapi? Kenapi....
english: I am making a bamboo tray. Thank you. Why? Why....
indonesian: Saya membuat klakat. Terima kasih. Bagaimana? Bagaimana..

balinese: Niki wawasta ngagem kanan. Niki mawasta ngagem kiri.
english: This is Agem Kanan. This is Agem Kiri.
indonesian: Ini namanya agem kanan. Ini namanya agem kiri.

balinese: Ampura masih niki, Beli ampun ngrepotin. Sampunang ja kenten, masih enu ngajak nyama.
english: I’m sorry too, to cause all the troubles (Lit: I am sorry too, Brother is causing all the troubles). Please don’t say that, we’re still related.
indonesian: Minta maaf juga, Kakak sudah merepotkan. Jangan begitu, juga masih sama saudara.

balinese: Ken luungan, ngulat klakat ken ngajang lemekan ne, Bu? Dadian lah anu..ngajang lemekan tiang.
indonesian: Mana lebih baik, menganyam klakat dengan mengangkut rabuk itu, Bu? Medingan lah anu..saya mengangkut rabuk.

balinese: Wenten kendala Pak yen ngajin-ngajin murid (en)to, Pak?
english: Are there obstacles to teaching those students, Sir?
indonesian: Adakah kendalanya Pak, kalau mengajar-mengajar murid itu, Pak?

balinese: Yen driki, Pak, ngambahin… ngaleran…
english: From here, sir, follow along...to the north....
indonesian: Kalau di sini, Pak, lewat… ke utara…

balinese: Ee..puniki nggih. Ee..mangkin, Pak, lurus driki ngalerang ten, kenten.
english: Eh...like this, right. Eh...now, yeah, Sir, go straight here to the north.
indonesian: Ee..begini ya. Ee..sekarang, Pak, lurus di sini ke utara kan, begitu.

balinese: Aji kuda jani yen sampine ba kanti payu to, Pak? Paling liu ji..kutus. Mm, kutus..apa ne, Pak? Kutus juta. Kutus juta. Dija biasane Pak ngadep? Ada kenene? Ada manten ngalih..sodagar. Mm sodagare to ne ngalih sampin Pak, kenten? Nggih.
indonesian: Berapa harga sapinya sekarang kalau sampai laku, Pak? Paling banyak seharga..delapan. Mm, delapan..apa ini, Pak? Delapan juta. Delapan juta. Di mana biasanya Pak menjualnya? Ada anunya? Ada saja yang mencari..saudagar. Mm saudagar itu yang mencari sapi Pak, begitu? Ya.

balinese: Buka nlimpuk takilan puyung, I Wayan Dunia kasengguh ngamaling pratima purane, yadiastun ia tusing nawang unduk apa-apa.
english: Like being tripped over an empty container, I Wayan Dunia was accused of stealing his Temple’s holy relic, even though he has nothing to do with the theft (said of a person who is blmaed for something bad or some wrong act, but who is innocent and did nothing wrong).
indonesian: Seperti tersandung bungkusan kosong, I Wayan Dunia disangka mencuri Pratima Puranya, walaupun ia tidak tahu apa-apa tentang hal itu.

balinese: Patut. Iriki wantah ngamargiang tetamban pangusadan, saged tur sane nenten ngwetuang pinyungkan sane tiosan.
english: That’s correct. Here we use herbal medicines that are effective with no side effects.
indonesian: Betul. Di sini menerapkan obat-obatan dengan teknik pengobatan herbal, manjur dan tidak akan mengakibatkan timbulnya sakit lainnya.

balinese: Ampun kenten, ngamenekang drika, tembus di Pasar Tampak Siring.
english: When you're already there, there's a road that goes up there, through to Tampak Siring market.
indonesian: Sudah begitu, jalan naik di sana, tembus di Pasar Tampak Siring.

balinese: Sapasira sane prasida nyawis pitaken puniki, pacang ngamolihang jinah saking prawartaka.
english: Anyone who can answer this question will get cash from the committee.
indonesian: Siapapun yang bisa menjawab pertanyaan ini, akan memperoleh uang tunai dari panitia.

balinese: Yening lakar ngajeng mangkin, menu napi sane becik? Restoran Arwana puniki madue menu special ngangge ulam segara taler ulam.
english: If I want to have lunch now, what is the best choice for lunch? Arwana restaurant has a special menu for seafood and meat.
indonesian: Kalau mau makan sekarang, menu apa yang enak? Restoran Arwana ini punya menu spesial ikan laut dan daging.

balinese: titiang nganggen baju
english: i use a t-shirt
indonesian: saya memakai baju

balinese: Wenten pertigaan drika. Nggih. Nganginang, Beli, nika.
english: There’s an intersection over there. Yes. Go east, Mate, over there.
indonesian: Ada pertigaan di sana. Ya. Ke timur, Kak, itu.

balinese: Eda cai bas ngarep tekén panak gelahé.
english: Don't you expect too much from my daughter.
indonesian: Jangan kamu terlalu berharap dengan anak saya.

balinese: Unteng tetujone wantah ngasilang asil pakaryan sane alami, nggih? Gedungne taler ageng tur becik.
english: The main purpose of this factory is to produce natural products, right? The building is huge and nice.
indonesian: Inti tujuannya adalah menghasilkan produk-produk yang alami, kan? Gedungnya juga besar dan bagus.

balinese: Geginan tiang ngateh-ngateh turis, sampun slae (25) tiban.
english: I have been working as a chauffeur for tourists for twenty five (25) years.
indonesian: Pekerjaan saya mengantarkan turis, sudah dua puluh lima (25) tahun.

balinese: Ring daja punika, wenten nika pertigaan. Beli, to ngauhang.
english: Due north, there’s an intersection. Go west, Mate.
indonesian: Di utara itu, ada itu pertigaan. Kakak, itu ke arah barat.

balinese: ...sarahina kenten manten anun tiang..maadolan manten, sareng ngayah-ngayah yen wenten kenten di pura nika, wenten upacara...
english: ...everyday I... work as a grocer, with the occasional community works at the temple, when there are ceremonies...
indonesian: ..sehari-hari begitu saja anu saya..berjualan saja, dengan ngayah-ngayah kalau ada begitu itu di pura, ada upacara...

balinese: Bu, napi manten e..geginan Ibu sawai-wai, Bu? Tiang ngecet, mrada.
english: Bu ... what ... er ... do you do every day? (Lit: What is your activity every day?) I paint ... I paint using gold paint.
indonesian: Bu, apa saja e..kegiatan Ibu sehari-hari, Bu? Saya mengecat, mengecat menggunakan perada.

balinese: Dewi ngecob benang di kamarné.
english: Dewi rolled the yarn in her room.
indonesian: Dewi menggulung benang di kamarnya.

balinese: Ia ngejoh.
english: He moved away.
indonesian: Ia menjauh.

balinese: Gunungé ngejoh-ngejohang.
english: The mountain is farther and farther away.
indonesian: Gunungnya makin lama makin jauh.

balinese: Yen, Pak, ke kiri, ring Lubuan…dados nika marginin, tapi ngejohan, Pak.
english: If you go to the left in Lubuan, you will still get there, but it will be further.
indonesian: Kalau, Pak, ke kiri, di Lubuan…bisa itu dilewati, tapi menjauh, Pak.

balinese: "Mancing ngejuk be" Bli de: "Cen be?" "ne"
english: "Catch a fish" Bli de: "Where are the fish?" "This is it"
indonesian: "Mancing mencari ikan" Bli de: "Mana ikannya ?" "ini"

balinese: Nggih, susukne malih duang tali limangatus (2.500). Sakewala ampura niki, Gus. Mbok jani sing ngelah limangatusan (500-an).
english: Sure, the change is twenty-five hundreds (2,500). But please forgive me, Gus. I don’t have five hundreds (500).
indonesian: Baik, kembaliannya lagi dua ribu lima ratus (2.500). Tapi maaf, Gus. Kakak sekarang tidak punya limaratusan(500-an).

balinese: Ring tongos sane kenken patutne, apang melah anggon ngelarang semadi, Kak?
english: Where is the appropriate place to meditate, Grandpa?
indonesian: Di tempat yang bagaimana sepatutnya, agar bisa melakukan semadi dengan baik, Kek?

balinese: Napi manten jenis seni tur gaya lukis sane kaanut olih pelukisne?
english: What are the artistic types and styles that the painters have?
indonesian: Apa saja jenis seni dan gaya lukis yang dianut oleh para pelukis ini?

balinese: Om Swastyastu, Bli. Om Swastyastu.
english: Peace be with you, Brother. Peace be with you.
indonesian: Om Swastyastu, Kak. Om Swastyastu.

balinese: Mangkin masyarakate sampun seneng tur oneng nglimbakang pertanian organik.
english: Nowadays, people enjoy and are knowledgeable about organic farming.
indonesian: Sekarang masyarakat sudah suka dan senang mengembangkan pertanian organik.

balinese: Pragat cacada dogen montor bebekne I Wayan ane suba tua teken krama banjare. Sakewala, yen suba perlu onyang nagih nyilih sakitan kenehne. Buka pait-paitan kopine, liu anake demen.
english: Wayan's motorcycle is always mocked by the people at banjar because it's very old. But, when they need it, all of them wants to use it. Like there's a proverb says, even coffee is bitter, many people love it.
indonesian: Motor bebeknya Wayan yang sudah tua selalu dicela oleh warga banjar. Akan tetapi, kalau sudah perlu, semua mau meminjam sesuka hatinya. Seperti pahit-pahitnya kopi, banyak orang yang suka.

balinese: Suba taen milu manyi satonden ene? Tusing taen, Mbok. Jani tulung orahin tiang.
english: Have you ever try harvesting before? Never, sister. Would you please tell me how.
indonesian: Sudah pernah ikut memanen padi sebelumnya? Belum pernah, Kak. Sekarang tolong beritahu saya.

balinese: Paané nyangkrik uli pidan.
english: His thigh is shaped like a thigh cricket from the past.
indonesian: Pahanya berbentuk seperti paha jangkrik dari dulu.

balinese: Nggih, ring genah iriki wenten akeh katandur sarwa entikan sane pacang kaanggen lakar tamba.
english: Yes, in this place many plants are used as herbal medicine.
indonesian: Iya, di tempat ini ada banyak ditanam bermacam tanaman yang akan digunakan sebagai bahan obat.

balinese: Pada girang maplalianan bias lan ombak.
english: They are all happy to play sand and waves.
indonesian: Mereka semua riang gembira bermain pasir dan ombak.

balinese: Gus, enu truna jani. Lamun nyidaang, suud maroko, nggih? Pedalem pipise tur kesehatane.
english: Gus, you are still single now. If you can, please quit smoking, okay? Don’t you feel bad for your money and health?
indonesian: Gus, sekarang masih bujang. Kalau bisa, berhenti merokok, ya? Kasihan uang dan kesehatannya.

balinese: Raris campurin baan serat kakao, tebihan don-donan, padang, miwah sane lianan.
english: And then mix it with cocoa fibers, shredded leaves, grass and other things.
indonesian: Lalu campurkan dengan serat kakao, potongan daun-daunan, rumput, dan yang lainnya.

balinese: Ia ngalih padang jampi.
english: He looked for a type of grass for drinking medicine.
indonesian: Ia mencari jenis rumput untuk obat minum.

balinese: Kawitan tiange ring Padarman Kresna Kepakisan. Oh, kenten.
english: My ancestors came from Padarman Kresna Kepakisan. Oh, really.
indonesian: Kawitan saya di Padarman Kresna Kepakisan. Oh, begitu.

balinese: Buka beruke takil I Gede Gerak, mapi-mapi mragatang wicaran banjare padidian.
english: Like a water pot from coconut shell. I Gede Gerak pretended to occupy himself with his own neighborhood’s problem.
indonesian: Seperti beruk (kendi dari tempurung kelapa) terbungkus, I Gede Gerak berpura-pura menyelesaikan perkara banjarnya sendirian.

balinese: Linggah pesan bale bengonge niki, samalihne paek sareng segara.
english: What a spacious gazebo, and it is close to the beach.
indonesian: Luas sekali bale bengong ini, dan juga dekat dengan pantai.

balinese: Napi manten.. e.. perluang e yen nak ngukir nika, Pak? Yen ngukir, yen ngadol nika kan kayu..kayu. Yen…paet, pangotok kan nika gen.
english: Guna; What is needed if someone wants to carve it, Sir? If you carve, if you sell the wood...wood. If... you just need a chisel and hammer.
indonesian: Apa saja e.. yang diperlukan.. e kalau orang mengukir itu, Pak? Kalau mengukir, kalau jualan itu kan kayu..kayu. Kalau…pahat, palu kan itu saja.

balinese: Sampun wénten ring paingkupan.
english: Already in agreement.
indonesian: Sudah ada di kesepakatan.

balinese: "Kopi pait dogen, Luh, Beli gaenang. To di kenyem Iluhe, jemak gulane". Wuih, apa greget cie? Tawang ci greget cange? Apa? Dibi cang magending. Terus engken? Sing mabayah!
english: "Black coffee, dear, made one for me. Your smile will be its sugar". Wow … what’s up with you? You want to know what’s up with me? Yes … what? Yesterday … I sang. Yes … and …? I didn’t get paid!
indonesian: "Kopi pahit saja, Dinda, Kakak dibuatkan. Itu di senyum Adinda, ambil gulanya". Wuih, apa geregetmu? Kamu tahu apa geregetku? Apa? Kemarin aku menyanyi. Terus bagaimana? Tidak dibayar!

balinese: Tan pajamuga.
english: Unexpected, not approximate.
indonesian: Tak tersangka-sangka, tak terkira-kira.

balinese: Ditu anaké pajodog.
english: There are many people who are quietly entrenched.
indonesian: Disana orang banyak yang diam bercokol.

balinese: Ditu anaké pajongkok.
english: There are many people who are squatting.
indonesian: Disana orang banyak yang berjongkok.

balinese: Motoré ulung pajririt.
english: Many falling motors roll quickly.

english: My hair is braided using red band.
indonesian: Rambut saya dijalinnya menggunakan karet merah.

balinese: Plintirang jep bok tiangé Dé !
english: Please braid my hair De !
indonesian: Tolong jalinkan rambut saya De !

balinese: Munyin gambelané plintut.
english: The 'gambelan' sound was irregular.
indonesian: Suara gambelannya tidak teratur.

balinese: Plipirang bukuné di duur lemariné.
english: Arrange the book above the cabinet so it would be lines neatly.
indonesian: Atur buku itu di atas lemari agar berderet rapi.

balinese: Bukuné plipiranga di tengah lemari.
english: The book was arranged neatly in the middle of the closet.
indonesian: Buku itu diaturnya dengan berderet rapi di tengah lemari.

balinese: Plisahang awaké ditu, tikehé suba telah.
english: Put yourself there without a base, the mat is gone.
indonesian: Dudukkan dirimu disana tanpa alas, tikarnya sudah habis.

balinese: Adinné plisahanga di natahé.
english: His younger brother was seated on the ground without mat on the yard.
indonesian: Adiknya didudukkan di tanah tanpa alas di halaman rumah.

balinese: Pamulan-mulané plisahina baan keboné.
english: The plant was seated and trampled by buffalo until it was broken.
indonesian: Tanaman itu diduduki dan diinjak-injak oleh kerbau sampai rusak.

balinese: Pliser tanggun benangé Dé !
english: Please twist the tip of the yarn De!
indonesian: Pilin ujung benang itu De !

balinese: Plispisan nasiné punduhina anggon maman siap.
english: The grains of rice that fell during the meal were collected for chicken feed.
indonesian: Butir-butir nasi yang jatuh pada waktu makan itu dikumpulkannya untuk pakan ayam.

balinese: Awakné metatu ulian plodor kebo.
english: His body was injured because of being attacked by a buffalo.
indonesian: Badannya terluka karena diseruduk kerbau.

balinese: Tiang listriké plodora kanti bah. Aget tusing ada anak ané tepéna.
english: The electric pole was hit by him until it fell. Luckily no one was affected.
indonesian: Tiang listrik itu diseruduknya hingga jatuh. Untungnya tidak ada orang yang tertimpa.

balinese: Plodotang muncuk besiné ento apang tusing lanying.
english: Bend the iron tip so as not to be sharp.
indonesian: Bengkok-bengkokkan ujung besi itu agar tidak tajam.

balinese: Nasiné plokpoka kanti telah baan céléngé.
english: The rice was eaten ravenously until it was finished by the pig.
indonesian: Nasinya dimakannya dengan lahap sampai habis oleh babi itu.

balinese: Plekak ploncoré aji palud.
english: Plug the 'ploncor' using cork.
indonesian: Sumbat ‘ploncor’ itu menggunakan gabus.

balinese: Ada lelawah di plosor biuné.
english: There are bats in the banana leaf buds.
indonesian: Ada kelelawar di tunas daun pisang itu.

balinese: Madé plungguha tekén pisagané ulian bes keras nyetél radio.
english: Made was given a complaint by his neighbor because he turned on the radio too loudly.
indonesian: Made dikeluhi oleh tetangganya karena menghidupkan radio terlalu keras.

balinese: Bapa maan plungguhan tekén pisagané.
english: Father got a complaint from his neighbor.
indonesian: Ayah mendapat pengaduan dari tetangganya.

balinese: Kubuné ento madinding baan plupuh.
english: The cottage is walled with bamboo halves.
indonesian: Pondok itu berdinding belahan bambu.

balinese: Plupuhang abiané aji tumbeg !
english: Please make a mound in the garden using a hoe!
indonesian: Buatkan guludan di kebun menggunakan cangkul !

balinese: Mémé ngaba padi a pocong.
english: Mother brings a bunch of rice.
indonesian: Ibu membawa satu ikat kecil padi.

balinese: Pocongan jagungé kelés. Aget tusing mebrarakan di jalané.
english: The bond of the corns was release. Luckily not scattered on the road.
indonesian: Ikatan kecil-kecil jagung itu terlepas. Untung tidak berserakan di jalan.

balinese: Pocongang padiné aji tali !
english: Bunch that rice using a rope!
indonesian: Ikatkan kecil-kecil padi itu menggunakan tali !

balinese: Rot pensilé apang tusing podol !
english: Shape the pencil so it's not blunt!
indonesian: Raut pensil itu agar tidak tumpul !

balinese: Podolang bedik bucun mejané. Yén kena limané bisa metatu.
english: Blunt the edge of the table a little. If it is hit by the hand, it can hurt.
indonesian: Tumpulkan sedikit ujung meja itu. Jika terkena tangan bisa terluka.

balinese: Tiuké suba poglo, tusing dadi anggon nués busung. Sangih malu apang mangan.
english: The knife is blunt, can not be used to cut coconut leaf. Sharpen it first.
indonesian: Pisau itu sudah tumpul, tidak bisa dipakai memotong janur. Asah dulu supaya tajam.

balinese: Eda ngawag-ngawag ngolah bé pogot. Béné ento misi racun.
english: Do not cook the pogot fish with carelessly. That fish contains poison.
indonesian: Jangan sembarangan mengolah ikan pogot. Ikan itu berisi racun.

balinese: Eda pogpog tekén tiang. Tiang sujatiné suba nawang.
english: Don't lie with me. I already know.
indonesian: Jangan bohong dengan saya. Saya sebenarnya sudah tahu.

balinese: Nyén lakar pogpogin cai buin ? Anaké suba nawang bikas cainé !
english: Who else would you lie to? Everyone knows your nature!
indonesian: Siapa lagi yang akan kamu bohongi ? Semua orang sudah tau sifatmu !

balinese: Tiang pogpogina tekén anaké ento.
english: I was lied to by that person.
indonesian: Saya dibohongi oleh orang itu.

balinese: Bapa mula poh amplem di abiané.
english: Father planted 'poh amplem' in the garden.
indonesian: Ayah menanam 'poh amplem' di kebun.

balinese: Mémé mula poh arum manis di abian.
english: Mothers plant ‘poh arum manis' in the garden.
indonesian: Ibu menanam ‘poh arum manis’ di kebun.

balinese: I meme ngalap poh eni anggo rujak.
english: Mother picks Kuwini fruit to make pickles.
indonesian: Ibu memetik buah mangga eni untuk membuat asinan.

balinese: Mémé ngorahin tiang meli poh gedang di peken.
english: Mother told me to buy ‘poh gedang’ at the market.
indonesian: Ibu menyuruh saya membeli ‘poh gedang’ di pasar.

balinese: Tiang mula poh golék di abian. Nanging kanti jani tusing taén mabuah.
english: I planted ‘poh golék’ in the garden. But until now it has never been bear fruit.
indonesian: Saya menanam ‘poh golék’ di kebun. Tetapi hingga sekarang belum pernah berbuah.

balinese: Bapa lakar mula poh lali jiwa lan poh madu di abianné.
english: Father will plant ‘poh lali jiwa’ and ‘poh madu’ at the garden.
indonesian: Ayah akan menanam ‘poh lali jiwa’ dan ‘poh madu’ di kebun.

balinese: Kemu mai tiang ngalihin poh manalagi lan poh santen. Nanging tusing ade anak ané ngelah punyanné utawi ngadep buahné.
english: I am looking for ‘poh manalagi’ and ‘poh santen’ here and there. But no one owns the tree or sells the fruit.
indonesian: Kesana kemari saya mencari ‘poh manalagi’ dan ‘poh santen’. Namun tidak ada orang yang memiliki pohonnya atau menjual buahnya.

balinese: Tiang demen nolih penganggo ané pojol.
english: I like to see simple clothes.
indonesian: Saya senang melihat pakaian yang sederhana.

balinese: Pokéng bé céléngé aji blakas !
english: Cut the pork with a machete!
indonesian: Potong- potong daging babi itu dengan parang !

balinese: Bé siapé pokénga aji blakas.
english: The chicken meat is cut into pieces using a machete.
indonesian: Daging ayam itu dipotong-potongnya menggunakan parang.

balinese: Pokpok tundun bapané Yan, asané liu misi buk.
english: Please pat father’s back Yan, it seems filled by a lot of dust.
indonesian: Tepuk-tepuk punggung ayah Yan, sepertinya banyak berisi debu.

balinese: Bok tiangé pokpoka ulian misi buk.
english: My hair was patted by her because filled up with dust.
indonesian: Rambut saya ditepuk-tepuknya karena berisi debu.

balinese: Bukuné pokpokina apang bukné ilang.
english: The book is patted to clean it from dust.
indonesian: Buku itu ditepuk-tepuknya agar debunya hilang.

balinese: Kayuné punika kaukir sekadi pola patra batun timun.
english: The wood is carved like a cucumber seed ornament pattern.
indonesian: Kayu itu diukir seperti pola ornamen berbentuk biji mentimun.

balinese: Melah gati polah anak ceriké ento. Lén pesan tekén bapané. Paripolahné tusing nyandang tuutin.
english: The behavior of that child is very good. It's very different from his father. His behavior is not worth imitated.
indonesian: Baik sekali tingkah laku anak itu. Berbeda sekali dengan ayahnya. Tingkah lakunya tidak pantas ditiru.

balinese: Poléd muané aji pupur !
english: Smear her face using powder!
indonesian: Coreng wajahnya menggunakan bedak !

balinese: Muan tiangé poléda aji adeng kanti poléng.
english: My face was smeared using charcoal until looks strip.
indonesian: Wajah saya dicorengnya menggunakan arang hingga belang.

balinese: Polédang limané aji boréh apang tis.
english: Smear your hands with param (kind of scrub) to make it feel cold.
indonesian: Oleskan tanganmu dengan param agar terasa dingin.

balinese: Jerijiné polédanga aji lengis apang bungkungné goloh tur aluh ngelésang.
english: His finger was smeared with oil so the ring was loose and easily removed.
indonesian: Jarinya diolesi minyak agar cincinnya longgar dan mudah melepaskannya.

balinese: Muané polédina aji pupur.
english: His face was smeared using powder.
indonesian: Wajahnya dicorengi menggunakan bedak.

balinese: Tiang meli baju mawarna poléng di peken.
english: I bought striped clothes on the market.
indonesian: Saya membeli baju berwarna belang di pasar.

balinese: Polés kayuné aji plitur.
english: Polish the wood with a lacquer.
indonesian: Oles kayu itu dengan pelitur.

balinese: Polésang lim kanji di kertasé apang nyak neket.
english: Apply the glue made from tapioca flour on the paper to make it stick.
indonesian: Oleskan lem berbahan tepung tapioka di kertas itu agar mau menempel.

balinese: Polésin boké aji lengis apang tusing tuh.
english: Brush your hair with oil to prevent it from drying out.
indonesian: Olesi rambutmu dengan minyak agar tidak kering.

balinese: E..makideh tiang polih makarya. E..ring gatsu polih titiang makarya. Ring Ubud polih. Titiang ring e..batubulan polih nika makarya.
english: Er .... I get work all over the place. In Jl Gatot Subroto I work. In Ubud I get it. I ... er ... in Batubulan I am able to work.
indonesian: E..ke mana-mana saya dapat kerja. E..di gatsu dapat saya bekerja. Di Ubud dapat. Saya itu di e..batubulan dapat bekerja.

balinese: Jlema tusing ngelah polo! Enu dogén melaksana buka kéto.
english: They’re kind of without-brain human ! They still behave like that.
indonesian: Manusia tidak berotak, masih saja bertingkah laku seperti itu.

balinese: Mémé méli polok di peken Badung.
english: I bought 'polok' (clay vessel) at the Badung market.
indonesian: Ibu membeli ‘polok’ (bejana dari tanah liat) di pasar Badung.

balinese: Ia liu pesan ngelah polok-polokan di paon.
english: He has a lot of small vessels in the kitchen.
indonesian: Dia banyak sekali memiliki bejana kecil di dapur.

balinese: Penganggoné polos gati. Ia mula tusing demen mapanganggo ané renteb.
english: His clothes are very simple. He really doesn't like to dress lively.
indonesian: Pakaiannya sangat sederhana. Dia memang tidak suka berpakaian yang meriah.

balinese: Polpol bangkiangné aji boréh.
english: Add her waist with param densely.
indonesian: Lepa pinggangnya dengan param.

balinese: Nasiné polpola aji sambel matah.
english: The rice is sprinkled with lots of raw chili.
indonesian: Nasinya dibubuhi sambal mentah banyak-banyak.

balinese: Polpolin liman cainé aji pupur apang tusing genit.
english: Add your hands with powder densely to prevent itching.
indonesian: Bubuhi tanganmu dengan bedak tebal agar tidak gatal.

balinese: Tiang sai ningehang anak ané ngucap poma di purané.
english: I used to heard people said ‘poma’ at the temple.
indonesian: Saya sering mendengar orang yang berkata ‘poma’ di pura.

balinese: Poma-poma pianak miwah cucuné sami nemu rahayu.
english: Hopefully his children and grandchildren all find prosperity.
indonesian: Mudah-mudahan anak dan cucunya semua menemukan kesejahteraan.

balinese: Karyané punika kalaksanayang duk rahina Soma Pon Sinta.
english: The ceremony is held on Monday ‘Pon’ (third day in Panca Wara) ‘Sinta’ (first ‘wuku’).
