english: My hair is cut short by my father. I am not permitted to have long hair.
indonesian: Rambut saya dicukur pendek oleh ayah. Saya tidak diizinkan berambut panjang.

balinese: Ida kocap akéh madué rukmi miwah mirah.
english: People said he had lots of gold and gems.
indonesian: Beliau katanya banyak memiliki emas dan permata.

balinese: Titiang ngantenang rukuh ring musium.
english: I saw ‘rukuh’ (a war hat covering the head to the nape of the neck) in the museum.
indonesian: Saya melihat ‘rukuh’ (topi perang yang menutupi kepala sampai tengkuk) di museum.

balinese: I raga patut setata rukun manyama braya.
english: We must always get along with our brothers and sisters and be in a community.
indonesian: Kita harus selalu rukun bersaudara dan bermasyarakat.

balinese: Rum ning puspita ngalimurang manah.
english: Fragrant flowers cheer hearts.
indonesian: Harumnya bunga menghibur hati.

balinese: Adukang rumbah lan jukut nangkané kanti rata.
english: Mix the chopped seasoning and vegetable jackfruit until blended.
indonesian: Campurkan bumbu cincang dan sayur nangka itu hingga rata.

balinese: Eda engsapina ngaé rumbah gilé anggon ngisinin banten pengabénanné.
english: Don't forget to make ah ‘rumbah gile’ to fill the offerings for the ceremony.
indonesian: Jangan lupa membuat ‘rumbah gile’ untuk mengisi sesajen upacara pengabenan.

balinese: Tiang rumbang dugas orahina masuk ka luar negri.
english: I was hesitant when I was told to go to school abroad.
indonesian: Saya bimbang ketika disuruh sekolah ke luar negeri.

balinese: Tanduk sampiné misi rumbing mawarna barak.
english: The cow's horn contains a red "rumbing" (decoration on the horn).
indonesian: Tanduk sapi itu berisi ‘rumbing’ (hiasan pada tanduk) berwarna merah.

balinese: Rumbingin tanduk sampiné satondén milu makepung.
english: Attach the 'rumbing' (cow horn decoration) on the horn of the cow before taking ‘makepung’ (cart race drawn by a pair of buffaloes or cows)
indonesian: Pasangi ‘rumbing’ (hiasan tanduk sapi) pada tanduk sapi itu sebelum mengikuti ‘makepung’ (balap cikar yang ditarik oleh sepasang kerbau atau sapi).

balinese: Rumik anaké mabalih wayang di pura.
english: The people that watching puppets at the temple was not crowded.
indonesian: Tidak ramai orang menonton wayang di pura.

balinese: Soal ulangan matematikané rumit gati. Kanti pengeng tiang mragatang.
english: The math exam questions are very difficult. Until I was confused I finished it.
indonesian: Soal ujian matematika itu sulit sekali. Hingga pusing saya menyelesaikannya.

balinese: Rumitang nga soal apang tusing aluh baana nyaurin teken muride.
english: Make questions more complicated so it's not too easy for students to answer them.
indonesian: Buat soal lebih rumit agar tidak terlalu mudah bagi siswa untuk menjawabnya.

balinese: Pekak demen gati nganggo rompi ané mawarna gadang ento.
english: Grandpa likes to wear that green vest.
indonesian: Kakek suka sekali memakai rompi yang berwarna hijau itu.

balinese: Makejang nyaman-nyamané teka rumpiuk di taman kota.
english: All of his brothers came to gather in the city park
indonesian: Semua saudara-saudaranya datang berkumpul di taman kota

balinese: Rumpiukang timpalé makejang, yén suba genep mara luas kema.
english: Gather all your friends, if it's complete then go there.
indonesian: Kumpulkan teman-teman semua, jika sudah lengkap barulah berangkat ke sana.

balinese: Murid-muridé rumpiukanga tekén guruné di lapanganngé tuni semengan.
english: The students were gathered by his teacher in the field this morning.
indonesian: Murid-murid itu dikumpulkan oleh gurunya di lapangan tadi pagi.

balinese: Rumrumang panak tiangé apang nyak masekolah !
english: Please persuade my child to go to school!
indonesian: Tolong bujuk anak saya agar mau bersekolah !

balinese: Rundah bayuné ulian ningeh orta tunangan tiangé ngajak anak muani lénan.
english: My heart is not calm when I heard the news of my boyfriend with another man.
indonesian: Tidak tenang hati saya mendengar kabar pacar saya bersama lelaki lain.

balinese: Rundingang malu tekén krama ané lenan satondén ngaé putusan.
english: Negotiate with other citizens before making a decision.
indonesian: Rundingkan dahulu dengan warga yang lain sebelum membuat keputusan.

balinese: Pawangunan baléné ento rundinganga ajak nyaman-nyamanné.
english: The construction of the building was negotiated with his brothers.
indonesian: Pembangunan gedung itu dirundingkannya bersama-saudara-saudaranya.

balinese: Rungka gati dugas tiang nglamar dadi pegawé ditu.
english: It’s very difficult when I applied to become an employee there.
indonesian: Susah sekali ketika saya melamar menjadi pegawai di sana.

balinese: Dadong tiangé suba rungkad. Jani dadong tuah nongos di jumah.
english: My grandmother had difficulty walking because of old age. Now grandma just stays at home.
indonesian: Nenek saya sudah susah berjalan karena lanjut usia. Sekarang nenek hanya diam di rumah.

balinese: Panakné Wayan mula rungsing. Demen gati ia ngengkebang sandal tiangé.
english: Wayan’s son is indeed nosy. He likes to hide my sandals.
indonesian: Anaknya Wayan memang usil. Dia suka sekali menyembunyikan sendal saya.

balinese: Eda kija-kija malu Luh, runguang panaké dini !
english: Don't go anywhere Luh, watch your child here!
indonesian: Jangan kemana-mana Luh, perhatikan anakmu di sini !

balinese: Panakné tusing runguanga ulian seleg magaé di kota.
english: His son ignored by him because he was busy working in the city.
indonesian: Anaknya tidak dihiraukannya karena sibuk bekerja di kota.

balinese: Runtag atin tiangé ulian panak tiangé tonden mulih kanti jani.
english: My heart is nervous because my child hasn't returned home until now.
indonesian: Hati saya gelisah karena anak saya belum pulang hingga sekarang.

balinese: “Runti bajun tiangé ané uék ento !”, keto raosné Pan Wayan.
english: "Sew my torn clothes by hands! ", Said Pak Wayan.
indonesian: "Jahit baju saya yang robek itu dengan tangan !”, begitu kata Pak Wayan.

balinese: Runtik gati anak ceriké totonan. Suba pang pindo sandal tiangé engkebanga.
english: That little kid is so nosy. He has hidden my sandal twice.
indonesian: Usil sekali anak kecil itu. Sudah dua kali sendal saya disembunyikannya.

balinese: Bantang taruné punika sampun renyah, punika mawinan runtuhanga mangda nénten wénten sané katiban.
english: The trunk of the tree is already fragile, which is why it was dropped so that nothing was crushed.
indonesian: Batang pohon itu sudah rapuh, itu sebabnya dijatuhkannya agar tidak ada yang tertimpa.

balinese: Alon-alon yéning nedun lontar mangda runtun.
english: Be careful when copying lontar (Balinese literature that uses rontal leaf media) so that it is sequential.
indonesian: Hati-hati jika menyalin lontar (pustaka Bali yang menggunakan media daun rontal) agar berurutan.

balinese: Runtutan acara puniki kakawitin antuk sembrama wacana saking bapak kepala sekolah.
english: The sequence of this event began with remarks from the principal.
indonesian: Urutan acara ini dimulai dengan sambutan dari bapak kepala sekolah.

balinese: Runyam gati panakné Madé. Makejang barang tiangé nagih pantiganga.
english: Made’s son can't keep motionless. All of my stuff want to be slammed by him.
indonesian: Anaknya Made tidak bisa diam. Semua barang saya ingin dibantingnya.

balinese: Putu pepesan runyuh yén ngaba motor. Suba pang pindo ia nomplok punyan nyuh di sisin jalané.
english: Putu often is not careful when riding a motorcycle. He hit a coconut tree on the side of the road twice.
indonesian: Putu sering kurang hati-hati jika mengendarai motor. Sudah dua kali dia menabrak pohon kelapa di pinggir jalan.

balinese: Ogoh-ogoh sané kakaryanin oleh para yowanané punika nyihnayang rupa raksana sané serem-serem.
english: Ogoh-ogoh (giant doll) made by young men characterizes a appearance of spooky monster.
indonesian: Ogoh-ogoh (boneka raksasa) yang dibuat oleh para pemuda mencirikan rupa raksasa yang seram-seram.

balinese: Ia ngréka lukisan anak bajang ané rupawan.
english: He painted a paintings of beautiful teenage girls.
indonesian: Dia melukis lukisan gadis remaja yang cantik.

balinese: Kamarné Wayan rupek buina kebus gati.
english: Wayan's room is narrow and very hot.
indonesian: Kamarnya Wayan sempit dan panas sekali.

balinese: Tiang nyilih pipis satus tali rupiah sig Pan Wayané.
english: I borrowed one hundred thousand rupiah at Pak Wayan.
indonesian: Saya meminjam uang seratus ribu rupiah di Pak Wayan seratus.

balinese: Yadiastun nyonyoné rupit, ia tileh jegég.
english: Even though her breasts are small, she is still beautiful.
indonesian: Walaupun payudaranya kecil, dia tetap cantik.

balinese: Tiang orahina ka peken tekén mémé dugas enu ruput.
english: I was told to go to the market by my mother in the early hours of the morning.
indonesian: Saya disuruh ke pasar oleh ibu ketika masih pagi-pagi buta.

balinese: Carik tiangé rurah ulian kena blabar.
english: My rice fields were damaged because of floods.
indonesian: Sawah saya rusak karena terkena banjir.

balinese: Komputer tiangé ruraha kanti tusing dadi buin anggon ngetik.
english: My computer was damaged by him so it can't be used to type again.
indonesian: Komputer saya dirusak olehnya hingga tidak bisa digunakan mengetik lagi.

balinese: I Nyoman buung ngantén ulian reramanné nadak tusing ngrestuin. Unduké ento rurianga tekén krama desané kanti jani.
english: I Nyoman failed to get married because his parents suddenly did not approve. It was made horrendous by the villagers until now.
indonesian: Si Nyoman batal menikah karena orang tuanya mendadak tidak merestui. Hal itu dihebohkan oleh warga desa hingga sekarang.

balinese: Belingannné Iluh ruru ulian ulung uli undagané.
english: Her womb is abort because she fall from the stairs.
indonesian: Kandungannya Iluh gugur karena jatuh dari tangga.

balinese: Taru puniki sané ruruh titiang, sané pacang kadadosang tamba.
english: This tree is what I'm looking for, which I will make medicine.
indonesian: Pohon ini yang saya cari, yang akan saya jadikan obat.

balinese: Umahné Madé jani tusing ngelah rurung pamesuan ulian urug longsor.
english: Made's house now has no way to get out because it was buried by a landslide.
indonesian: Rumahnya Made sekarang tidak punya jalan untuk keluar karena ditimbiun longsor.

balinese: Mamargi kemanten ring margi sané rurus puniki, yéning sampun rauh ring tanggun margi, drika grian idané.
english: Just walk on this straight road, if you has arrived at the end of the road, there is his house.
indonesian: Jalan saja di jalan yang lurus ini, jika sudah tiba di ujung jalan, di sana rumah beliau.

balinese: Rurusang batisé apang tusing liu nelahang tongos.
english: Straighten your legs so you don't spend too much space.
indonesian: Luruskan kakimu agar tidak banyak menghabiskan tempat.

balinese: Sepédan titiangé sampun rusak. Titiang nénten madué jinah anggén menain ring béngkél.
english: My bicycle is damaged. I don't have money to fix it in the workshop.
indonesian: Sepeda saya sudah rusak. Saya tidak punya uang untuk memperbaikinya di bengkel.

balinese: Saang pamuun sampun kacumasiwang sadurung ngeseng layon.
english: The fire wood that had been roasted by the priest to ignite firstly had prepared before burning the corpse.
indonesian: Kayu api yang dimantrai oleh pendeta untuk menyulut pertama kali sudah disiapkan sebelum membakar mayat.

balinese: Tiang orahina meli saang sulah tekén mémé di peken.
english: I was told to buy white pepper by the mother on the market.
indonesian: Saya disuruh membeli lada putih oleh ibu di pasar.

balinese: Ia saapan laut nigtig mejané ento.
english: He was suddenly angry then hit the table.
indonesian: Dia marah dengan tiba-tiba lalu memukul meja itu.

balinese: Keneh tiangé lakar megaé di kapal pesiar suba saat.
english: My intention to work at a cruise ship is enterprising
indonesian: Kemauan saya akan bekerja di kapal pesiar sudah giat.

balinese: Saatang megaé apang énggal pragat lan énggal mulih.
english: Try hard to get it over quickly and quickly go home.
indonesian: Giatkan bekerja agar cepat selesai dan cepat pulang.

balinese: Para mantriné malinggih ring saba ning puri.
english: The ministers reside in areas outside the palace.
indonesian: Para menteri bertempat tinggal di daerah luar istana.

balinese: Titiang sabéng puri yening wénten karya sané pacang kalaksanayang irika.
english: I often come to the palace if there is an event to be held there.
indonesian: Saya sering datang ke istana jika ada acara yang akan diadakan di sana.

balinese: Oh nggih, nggih, sane ngangge laad mungkus kopi, sabun, lan tepung.
english: Oh yes, yes, wich use containers from coffee, soap, and flour.
indonesian: Oh iya, ya, yang menggunakan bekas bungkus kopi, sabun, dan tepung.

balinese: Ia mula anak ane tusing bisa ngawales legaan reramane, buka cicinge singal mara dibi belianga sepeda motor saget biin nagih mobil.
english: He is such a spoiled brat. Like a pampered puppy, his father just bought him a new motorcycle yesterday and now he’s already demanding for a car (used if a person is spoiled by someone else).
indonesian: Ia memang anak yang tidak bisa membalas kasih sayang orang tuanya. Seperti anjing yang makin lama makin berani karena dimanjakan, baru kemarin dibelikan sepeda motor tiba-tiba lagi minta mobil.

balinese: Peh, tumben-tumben meriki, napi lakar sagiang tiang?
english: Gee, such a rarity coming in here, what can I serve you (Lit: what can you be served by me)?
indonesian: Wah, tumben ke sini, apa yang akan saya hidangkan?

balinese: Wenten kendala Pak yen ngajin-ngajin murid (en)to, Pak? Wenten sih kendalane. E…ken murid nika..SMP nika..sukeh nika, agak sukeh nika ngatur, kenten. Mm. Terus..masalah gajih nika kendalane. Akidik sajaan tiang polih gajih. Akuda Pak polih gajih? Tuah Sembilan ratus nika. Ten ja akeh nika. O per bulan polih sembilan ratus. Nggih, per bulan.
indonesian: Adakah kendalanya Pak kalau mengajar-mengajar murid itu, Pak? Ada sih kendalanya. E…kan murid itu..SMP itu..itu sulit, agak sulit itu diatur, begitu. Mm. Terus..masalah gaji itu kendalanya. Sangat sedikit saya mendapat gaji. Berapa Pak dapat gaji? Hanya Sembilan ratus itu. Itu tidaklah banyak. O per bulan dapat sembilan ratus. Iya, per bulan.

balinese: Ayah-ayah puniki sajeroning jagi nyanggra puja wali ring rahina Kuningan sane jagi rauh.
english: These volunteering works were taken for the upcoming ceremony at Kuningan.
indonesian: Kegiatan sukarela ini dalam rangka menyambut puja wali (upacara di Pura) pada hari Kuningan yang akan datang.

balinese: Sakewanten amonean manten, nggih. Orang tua titiang, Bapan titiang makarya dados tukang, dados tukang.. magaenin umah, dados buruh. Yen memen titiang..e..pateh masih maburuh kari nika. Nggih, suksma.
english: Okay, that’s about all for now. My parents, my father work as a laborer, as a laborer.. building house, doing manual labor. While my mother...err.. she’s also does manual labor. Right, thank you.
indonesian: Akan tetapi sebegini saja, ya. Orang tua saya, Bapak saya bekerja menjadi tukang, jadi tukang.. membuat rumah, jadi buruh. Kalau ibu saya..e..itu sama juga masih menjadi buruh. Ya, terima kasih.

balinese: Om Swastiastu. Wastan titiang Ni Putu Diantari. Tiang saking Banjar Selat Tengah, Susut, Bangli. Tiang mangkin masekolah ring SMA Negeri Satu Susut. E..kegiatan titiang sehari-hari wantah ngukir. Suksma.
english: Peace. My name is Ni Putu Diantari. I'm from Selat Tengah banjar in Susut, Bagli. I go to school in Negeri Satu Susut High School. Eh...my daily activity is just to carve. Thank you.
indonesian: Om Swastiastu. Nama saya Ni Putu Diantari. Saya dari Banjar Selat Tengah, Susut, Bangli. Saya sekarang bersekolah di SMA Negeri Satu Susut. E..kegiatan saya sehari-hari hanyalah mengukir. Terima kasih.

balinese: Yening punika, tiang sedek sakit napi puniki?
english: Based on that, what kind of illness might I have?
indonesian: Kalau begitu, saya sedang sakit apa ini?

balinese: Dadosne pabrike lan para petanine saling tulungin ngaryanin usaha sane kamargiang iriki, nggih?
english: So the factory and the farmers are helping each other to run the business here, right?
indonesian: Jadinya, pabrik dan para petaninya saling membantu melakukan usaha yang dijalankan di sini, ya?

balinese: Wewangsalan: buka siap sambehin injin. Kilang-kileng
indonesian: Tamsil: seperti ayam ditaburkan ketan hitam. Tengok kiri tengok kanan berulang-ulang

balinese: Yening keto, tiang meli ane jangkep manten, Beli. Sambilang tiang mawisata kuliner, he he...
english: If that so, I am just going to purchase the folded one, Brother. Meanwhile I do my culinary tourism, he he…
indonesian: Kalau begitu, saya beli yang lengkap saja, Kak. Sambil saya berwisata kuliner, he he…

balinese: Putu Mirna nyakan sambilanga ngoreng be.
english: Putu Mirna cooks rice while frying fish.
indonesian: Putu Mirna memasak nasi sambil menggoreng ikan.

balinese: Sadurungne naenin ngambil karya napi, Pak, malih, selain ngukir? Maubuh-ubuhan, kenten,..naenin taler, Pak? Yen ngubuh bebek..nika ten taen. Ngubuh sampi, pidan-pidan sedereng ngukir taen ngubuh sampi.
english: And before that ... what sort of work did you do? ... apart from carving? Looking after animals ... that sort of thing ... did you ever do that? As for raising ducks ... I never did that. Raising cattle ... a long time ago before carving .. I used to raise cattle.
indonesian: Sebelumnya pernah ambil kerja apa, Pak, lagi, selain mengukir? Beternak, begitu,..pernah juga, Pak? kalau memelihara itik..itu saya tidak pernah. Memelihara sapi, dulu-dulu sebelum mengukir pernah memelihara sapi.

balinese: Sampun ked di Desa Selat Peken, nika kan….wenten jembatan, bendungan abuan nika,
english: After you are in Selat Peken village, yes...there is a bridge, a greyish dam...
indonesian: Sudah sampai di Desa Selat Peken, itu, kan….ada jembatan, bendungan abuan itu

balinese: Sang Prabu nitahang panjaknyané mangda mataki-taki ngaryanin upakara.
english: The king ordered his people to get ready to make ceremonial means.
indonesian: Raja memerintahkan rakyatnya untuk bersiap-siap membuat sarana upacara.

balinese: Klakat napi manten ne karyanin, Ibu? Klakat…a..sangggah cucuk.
indonesian: Klakat apa saja yang dibuat, Ibu? Klakat…a..sangggah cucuk.

balinese: Nganti jam kuda Putra lakar nyewa sepedane niki? Nganti nyanan sanja manten, Beli.
english: Until what time will you rent this bike? Until this evening, Brother.
indonesian: Sampai jam berapa Putra akan menyewa sepeda ini? Sampai nanti sore saja, Kak.

balinese: Anggen basa pergaulan, santukan basa Bali nika.. bahasa ibu.
english: As intercommunication language, because the Balinese language is our mother tongue.
indonesian: Sebagai bahasa pergaulan, karena bahasa Bali adalah bahasa ibu.

balinese: Om Swastyastu. Ring rahina ne mangkin tyang ngaturang peras pejati. Niki wastane santun, niki wastane peras ajengan, niki wastane tipat dampulan. Asapunika, Suksma.
english: Om Swastyastu. In this holy day, I present an offering called peras pejati. This is santun, this is peras ajengan, this is tipat dampulan. Thank you.
indonesian: Om Swastyastu. Pada perayaan hari ini, saya mempersembahkan peras pejati. Ini namanya santun, ini peras ajengan, ini tipat dampulan. Sekian, Terima kasih.

balinese: Sapunapi indik inumanne? Jagi minum napi?
english: What about the beverages? What would you like to drink?
indonesian: Bagaimana dengan minumannya? Mau minum apa?

balinese: Om Swastyastu. Ring dina ne mangkin, Rahina Saraswati, ngiring sareng-sareng ngaturin persembahyangan ring Padmasana sekolah mangda ngemolihin rahayu..kerahayuan lan kerahajengan.
english: Om Swastyastu. Today, the Saraswati day, let's pray together at the school's temple to receive peace and prosperity.
indonesian: Om Swastyastu. Hari ini, Hari Saraswati, mari bersama-sama menghaturkan persembahyangan di Padmasana sekolah supaya mendapatkan kedamaian dan kemakmuran.

balinese: Napi sane wenten saratang Sari? Tiang jagi mlajah indik yoga nika, Beli.
english: What can I do for you, Sari? I would like to learn yoga, Brother.
indonesian: Apa yang Sari perlukan? Saya hendak belajar mengenai yoga, Kak.

balinese: Adan tiang Ni Wayan Resiani. Geginan tiang sadina-dina, semengne nika madagang sayur. Siang..e..Siangne nika madagang rujak sareng es..
english: My name is Ni Wayan Resiani. What I do everyday, in the morning I sell vegetables. At noon… eehhh… At noon a sell balinese Fruit salad and cold beverages.
indonesian: Nama saya Ni Wayan Resiani. Kegiatan saya sehari-hari, paginya itu berjualan sayur. Siang..e..Siangnnya itu berjualan rujak dan es..

balinese: Tiang meled jagi melajah yoga sareng semadi, punapi nika carane?
english: I’m so interested in learning yoga and meditation, how could I do it?
indonesian: Saya ingin sekali belajar yoga dan semadi, bagaimana carannya?

balinese: E…rencana tiang mangkin, tiang jagi buka usaha sareng…partner tiange, soulmate tiang.
english: Eh...my plan now is to open a business together with my friend, my soulmate.
indonesian: E…rencana saya sekarang, saya akan buka usaha bersama…teman saya, belahan jiwa saya.

balinese: Suksma, Beli. Nggih, sareng-sareng.
english: Thank you, Brother. Sure, you are welcome.
indonesian: Terima kasih, Kak. Iya, sama-sama.

balinese: Saringan santené suba bolong pakpak bikul.
english: The coconut milk filter has a hole bitten by a mouse.
indonesian: Saringan santan itu sudah berlubang digigit tikus.

balinese: Tiang sujatiné suba nawang yéning Ketut lan Wayan saruron lakar ngrebut warisan tiangé.
english: I actually already knew if Ketut and Wayan were cooperating to win my inheritance.
indonesian: Saya sebenarnya sudah tahu jika Ketut dan Wayan bekerja sama akan merebut warisan saya.

balinese: Dugase ento, ada macan muani sedekan nglincak ngalih amah-amahan ane marupa beburon, sawireh I macan mula ya buron sarwa baksa. Kala ento, tepukina ada pianak jarane nu cenik-cenik ajaka dadua, mula tuah liwat jaen yan kabaksa baan macane.
english: At that moment, there was a tiger walking around looking for food in the form of an animal of prey because the tiger is indeed an animal that eats everything. And then he saw two ponies that were really quite small. They would be truly very tasty if they were to be eaten by the tiger.
indonesian: Pada saat itu, ada harimau jantan sedang berjalan-jalan mencari makanan berupa binatang perburuan, karena si harimau memang binatang pemakan segala. Kala itu, dilihatnya ada dua ekor anak kuda masih kecil-kecil. Memang benar kelewat enak jika dimakan harimau tersebut.

balinese: Adepa di Kelating, baanga pipis satak.
english: To be sold at Kelating for two hundred.
indonesian: Dijual di Kelating, diberi uang dua ratus.

balinese: Satonden niki…abis kiamat dunia niki, jeg ten ampun.. abis-abisne niki. Napi buin kenten.. niki roh-roh niki ampun…kari. Makin nurun menurun.., napi jalan keluar. Ten nyidaang ngelepas niki.
english: Before this...the doomsday of the world, its not...completely over. Moreover...these spirits have already...they are still there. The more they go from generation to generation, which is the way out. They can't be released.
indonesian: Sebelum ini…habis kiamat dunia ini, tidaklah.. habis-habisnya ini. Apa lagi anu.. ini roh-roh ini sudah…masih ada. Makin turun menurun.., apa jalan keluar. Tidaklah bisa melepas ini.

balinese: Om Swastiastu. Tiang..titiang sareng timpal-timpal jagi…mangkin jagi ngaturang…jagi…satua “Ni Bawang teken Ni Kesuna”. Katuturang satua anak makurenan, ngelah kone pianak luh-luh duang diri.
english: Om Swastiastu. Me and my friends are going to tell..going to..a folktale “Ni Bawang teken Ni Kesuna”. Once upon a time there was a husband and wife couple, with their two daughters.
indonesian: Om Swastiastu. Saya bersama teman-teman akan..sekarang akan menyampaikan…akan..cerita “Ni Bawang teken Ni Kesuna” Diceritakan sepasang suami istri, mempunyai dua orang anak perempuan.

balinese: Yen arahina…aji kuda Ibu maan madagang biasane, Bu? Yen bubuh manten, polih ji..paling keras ji tujuh puluh duang kilo, yen bubuh manten. Yen madaging sela satus duang (d)asa polih. Yen batine kira-kira kuda maan bati, Bu? Yen hari Minggu tiang maan seket. Yen kesehariane paling keras tiga puluh. Nah ramene, petang dasa tiang maan.
english: If in a day ... how much do you get to sell normally, ma'am? If it is just porridge, it can be at most seventy (for) two kilos, if only porridge. If it contains sweet potatoes, you get one hundred and twenty. What about the profit, ma'am?
indonesian: Kalau dalam sehari…seberapa Ibu perolehan berjualannya biasanya, Bu? Kalau bubur saja, dapat ..paling tinggi tujuh puluh (untuk) dua kilo, kalau bubur saja. Kalau berisi ubi dapat seratus dua puluh. Kalau untungnya kira-kira berapa dapat untung, Bu? Kalau hari Minggu saya dapat lima puluh. Kalau kesehariannya paling tinggi tiga puluh. Nah (waktu) ramainya, empat puluh saya dapat.

balinese: Oh, kenten. Tiang bareng sebet ningehang kurenan Mboke ten kari.
english: Oh, like that. I am so sorry to hear for the lost of your husband.
indonesian: Oh, begitu. Saya jadi ikut sedih mendengar suami Kakak sudah tiada.

balinese: Anak alit pengungsi Gunung Agung sedekan mlajah aksara Bali ring pengungsian.
english: A child evacuee from Gunung Agung is learning Balinese script while at the Evacuation Centre.
indonesian: Anak pengungsi Gunung Agung sedang belajar aksara Bali di pengungsian.

balinese: Ia sedih ajan krana tunanganne suba mati.
english: She is so sad because her boyfriend has passed away.
indonesian: Dia sedih karena pacarnya sudah meninggal.

balinese: Sakadi ngangge tiiing kadi puniki, nggih?
english: Such as the use of bamboo, right?
indonesian: Sebagaimana penggunaan bambu seperti ini, ya?

balinese: Nah, yéning arahina aji kuda biasané, Bu, polih? Polih nyeng ji séket tali, Pak.
english: Well, if one day, how many can you usually get, Madam? I'm able to get about 50,000, Sir.
indonesian: Nah, kalau sehari berapa biasanya dapat, Bu? Dapat sekitar lima puluh ribu, Pak.

balinese: Terus selat kaja kauh, terus notok nga..nuunang, wenten.. wenten jembatan, perbatasan Tampak Siring jak Selat.
english: Go straight until the northern border, go along until the end...go down, there is....there is a bridge, at the border of Tampak Siring and Selat.
indonesian: Terus batas utara barat, terus ikuti jalan sampai habis..menurun, ada.. ada jembatan, perbatasan Tampak Siring dan Selat.

balinese: Anggena napi manten lemekan nika, Ibu? Anggena mupuk semaga di Kintamani.
indonesian: Dipakai apa saja rabuk itu, Ibu? Dipakai memupuk jeruk di Kintamani.

balinese: Ubad sakit pilek: lablab a kepel don sembung antuk yeh a gelas. Isinin gula batu utawi madu a bedik. Raris minum.
english: A treatment for colds: boil a handful of Sambung leaves in 1 glass of water. Add sugar or honey as required and then drink the liquid.
indonesian: Obat pilek: rebuslah segenggam daun sembung dalam segelas air panas. Tambahkan gula batu atau madu secukupnya, lalu minumlah.

balinese: Raras cara Kuta, semu cara Badung.
english: He acts like a native of Kuta, his countenance resembles those from Badung.
indonesian: Gayanya seperti orang Kuta, air mukanya seperti orang Badung.

balinese: Punika pakaryan becik. Tiang taler seneng ring fotograpi.
english: That's a good job. I am also interested in photography.
indonesian: Itu pekerjaan bagus. Saya juga senang dengan dunia fotografi.

balinese: Carane kene. Ulengang kenehe, satmakane Sari ada di tongos ane sepi lan asri.
english: This is how we do it. Imagine yourself in a tranquil and beautiful place.
indonesian: Caranya begini. Fokuskan pikiran, seakan Sari ada di tempat yang sepi dan asri.

balinese: Adi sing bareng jadi anggota BPC, Bali Photography Community? Nah serahan poto ane gelah Adine melah kemu ke grup BPC.
english: Adi, aren’t you a member of the BPC, Bali Photography Community? Please upload your good pictures to BPC group.
indonesian: Adi tidak ikut jadi anggota BPC, Bali Photography Community? Nah serahkan saja foto-foto menarik yang Adi miliki ke grup BPC itu.

balinese: Ubad sakit pengeng: Sere, anggen ubad sakit pengeng. Panggang a katih sere raris keprok. Irup aroma ipun makadi aroma terapi.
english: HEADACHE: Lemon Grass can be used to treat a headache. Roast one stalk of Lemon Grass and then crush it. Inhale the aroma from the stalk as you would with aroma therapy.
indonesian: Obat Sakit kepala: Sereh/Serai bisa dipakai untuk obat sakit kepala. Pangganglah satu batang sereh/serai kemudian keprok. Hirup aroma batang tersebut seperti layaknya menghirup aromaterapi.

balinese: SERET : Munyin tiange serak liu anake ngorahin naar loloh kayu manis ane lakarnne aji don kayu manis miwah juuk nipis.
english: HOARSENESS: Many people told me to drink Star Gooseberry (Sauropus androgynus) leaves herb mix, which is made from Star Gooseberry leaves and key lime (Citrus aurantifolia).
indonesian: SUARA SERET: Banyak orang memberitahu untuk minum minuman kayu manis yang bahanya terbuat dari daun kayu manis dan jeruk nipis

balinese: Ane nomer kalih kari TK. Kegiatan tiang sesai-saine wantah nyait. Nyait mesin sareng..kenten..serabutan.
english: The second (child) is in kindergarten. My everyday activity is just sewing. (I) sew using a (sewing) machine ... er ... (to sew) whatever I have to.
indonesian: Yang nomor dua masih TK. Kegiatan saya sehari-hari hanya menjahit. Menjahit memakai mesin (jahit) dengan..anu..serabutan.

balinese: Nggih, niki wantah utsahane iriki sajeroning nyanggra upaya ngilmbakang kaasrian sumber daya alam, sane sida nglanturang kauripan sarwa pranine.
english: Yes, we are trying to support the development of sustainable natural resources.
indonesian: iya, ini hanyalah usaha di sini guna menjaga upaya pengembangan kelestarian sumber daya alam, yang dapat menjaga keberlanjutan kehidupan semua makhluk hidup.

balinese: Tusing pantes i raga nyacad kajelekan timpal. Buka ngae klambine, masih sikutang malu di awake.
english: It is not wise to denounce our friend's wickedness. Just like sewing a shirt, we need to measure ourselves.
indonesian: Tidak pantas kita mencela keburukan teman. Seperti membuat baju, diukur dulu juga di badan sendiri.

balinese: Nggih, dados. Malih pidan ja Ayu jagi singgah ring umah tiange, rarisang, silih manten.
english: Yes, you may. When you happen to visit my house, by all means, just borrow it.
indonesian: Ya, bisa. Kapan saja Ayu singgah ke rumah saya, silakan pinjam.

balinese: Oh, becik pisan! Yéning Ayu madué galah, ngiring simpang ring studion tiangé. Nggih, suksma.
english: Oh that's great! If you have time, please come visit my studio (Lit. If Ayu has time, please come visit my studio). Yes, thank you.
indonesian: Oh, bagus sekali! Kalau Ayu ada waktu, mari mampir di studio saya. Iya, terima kasih.

balinese: Umahné Putu sing ngenah uli dini.
english: Putu's house is not visible from here.
indonesian: Rumahnya putu tidak terlihat dari sini.

balinese: Kenken kabare, Yu? Becik Beli, wenten napi niki adi tumben singgah mriki?
english: How are you, Yu? I’m good Brother, on what occasion are you stopping by here?
indonesian: Apa kabar, Yu? Baik Kak, ada apa ini kok tumben mampir ke sini?

balinese: Selanjutnya adalah bulu pada ketiak. Ketiak ini bahasa Balinya adalah sipah. Jadinya bulu..bulu ketiak adalah bulu sipah.
english: Next is the hair found in the underarm. The underarm is called "sipah" in Balinese. It follows the hair... the underarm hair is called "bulu sipah".
indonesian: Selanjutnya adalah bulu pada ketiak. Ketiak ini bahasa Balinya adalah sipah. Jadinya bulu..bulu ketiak adalah bulu sipah.

balinese: Yaning sisa sane marupa limbah éncéh, punapi nika carane ngolah?
english: For the excess waste that is in a liquid form, how do you recycle it?
indonesian: Kalau sisa yang berupa limbah cair, bagaimana cara mengolahnya?

balinese: Durusang ngranjing. Beli Putra jagi malinggih ring tengah napi ring sisi?
english: Please come in. Would you prefer to have your lunch inside or outside?
indonesian: Silakan masuk. Kak Putra mau duduk di dalam atau di luar?

english: One thousand rupiah in Balinese is "siu rupiah". "siu" mean a thousand and "rupiah", it went the same.
indonesian: Seribu rupiah ini bahasa Balinya adalah siu rupiah. Siu itu artinya adalah seribu dan rupiah, biasa.

balinese: Nénten, panyakit kanker kémanten kantos slikur (21) tetanduran sané karacik.
english: No, for cancer disease you must mix twenty-one (21) ingredients.
indonesian: Tidak, penyakit kanker saja sampai dua puluh satu (21) tanaman yang diracik.

balinese: Bebladbadan: mataluh nyuh (tombong-red), sombong.
indonesian: Metafora: bertelur kelapa, sombong

balinese: Titiang taru sotong. Daging anget, rasa sepet, don dumalada, titiang dados kaanggen tamba pangemped mising. Ambil muncuk titiang raris kacampur antuk ketumbah (tigang besik) tur lunak, (ulig), raris kaanggen papuser ring pungsed.
english: I am the guava tree. My substance is hot, the taste is bitter and the leaves are moderate. To prevent and inhibit diarrhea, take some of the young leaves and finely ground them. Then mix with three pieces of cilantro and tamarind.
indonesian: Saya pohon jambu biji, kandungan zatnya panas, rasa sepat, daun sedang, digunakan untuk mencegah dan menghambat diare. AmbiI bagian daun yang muda, digiling halus, untuk penempel bagian pusar, dicampur ketumbar bolong tiga bill, dan buah asam.

balinese: Tetueknyane ngangge srana sane alami, punika nggih?
english: That means using natural materials, right?
indonesian: Maknanya memakai bahan yang alami, begitu kan?

balinese: Makejang timpalné suba sregep.
english: All of her friends were ready.
indonesian: Semua temannya telah bersedia.

balinese: Sing dadi makan kalo sing warung sukla.
english: I am not permitted to eat if it’s not at a sacred restaurant.
indonesian: Tidak boleh makan kalau tidak warung suci.

balinese: O kenten. Nggih. Suksma, Gus, nggih. Nggih, nggih.
english: Oh like that. Oh, thank you, ok. Ok. ok.
indonesian: O begitu. Ya. Terima kasih, Gus, ya. Ya, ya.

balinese: sunan
Kaping kalih, ngusudin angga sang sane sungkan.
english: Second, touch parts of the body that feel sick.
indonesian: Yang kedua, menyentuh anggota badan yang sakit.

balinese: Hmm… genep pisan nika dagingne! Tiang jagi nulis surat.
english: Hmm… what complete facilities! I need to send emails.
indonesian: Hmm… lengkap sekali fasilitasnya! Saya akan menulis surat.

balinese: Tiang lakar nukarang jinahe malu, nggih? Ten wenten susuk niki.
english: I am going to exchange the money first, is that ok? I have no change.
indonesian: Saya mau menukarkan uangnya dulu, ya? Tidak punya kembalian.

balinese: Dugasé magibung di Banjar, ulian waregné I Madé mesuang taag di malun anaké. Ngae lek tiang ane dadi beliné, anaké ngadénang tiang tusing taen ngajahin Adi ané madan tata krama.
english: When Magibung (a tradition of eating together) at Balai Banjar, I Made were belching in front of people. Makes me embarrassed as his brother, people think I have never educated my sister about manners.
indonesian: Ketika magibung (tradisi makan bersama) di Balai Banjar, I Made mengeluarakan serdawa di depan orang-orang. Membuat saya malu sebagai kakaknya, orang-orang berfikir saya tidak pernah mendidik Adik tentang tata krama.

balinese: Taan gigis tiying penjoré apang tusing makisidan.
english: Hold a little of that penjor bamboo so that it doesn't shift.
indonesian: Tahan sedikit bambu penjor itu agar tidak bergeser.

balinese: Tiinge ento taana aji kayu apang tusing nglayut.
english: The bamboo is held by him using wood to prevent it from clinging.
indonesian: Bambu itu ditahannya menggunakan kayu agar tidak bergayut.

balinese: Taanang seduk basang cainé, buin akejep anak lakar maan magibung.
english: Bear your hungry feeling, people will magibung soon (the tradition of eating together).
indonesian: Tahankan perutmu yang lapar, sebentar lagi orang akan magibung (tradisi makan bersama).

balinese: Taananga seduk basangné ulian lek lakar ngidih nasi dini.
english: He bear his hungry stomach in shame to ask for rice here.
indonesian: Ditahankanya perutnya yang lapar karena malu untuk meminta nasi di sini.

balinese: Telah taas don kayuné sabilang kena ujan abu Gunung Agung.
english: Many plants are fall when it’s exposed to the ash rain of Mount Agung.
indonesian: Banyak tumbuhan gugur setiap terkena hujan abu Gunung Agung.

balinese: Taasang punyan kayuné ento apang iragé bakatang saangné.
english: Drop the tree so we get the firewood.
indonesian: Gugurkan pohon itu agar kita dapatkan kayu bakarnya.

balinese: Telah taasanga bungan jepun tiangé ane mara mentik ban siapné I Pekak.
english: All of my new frangipani flower were fallen by Grandpa's chicken.
indonesian: Bunga kamboja saya yang baru tumbuh habis digugurkan oleh ayamnya Kakek.

balinese: Luh, kaat malu jajane dadi limang tabag ! Jani Mémé enu nulukang saang di paon.
english: Luh, cut the cake first into five thick slices! Now Mother is turning on firewood in the kitchen.
indonesian: Luh, potong dulu kue itu menjadi lima irisan yang tebal-tebal ! Sekarang Ibu sedang menghidupkan kayu bakar di dapur.

balinese: Tabah sajan anak cenikné I Ketut menék punyan binginé ento, sing koné ia nawang madan takut?
english: How dare is Ketut’s son climb the banyan tree, doesn't he feel scared?
indonesian: Berani sekali anaknya Si Ketut menaiki pohon beringin itu, tidakah ia merasa takut?

balinese: Bapak Jokowi, yening dados titiang mabesen. Tabahang ragané ngelawan koruptor ring jagat Indonesiané puniki.
english: Mr. Jokowi, may I give a suggestion. Be brave against this corruptor in Indonesia.
indonesian: Bapak Jokowi, bolehkah saya meberi saran. Beranikan dirimu melawan koruptor di negeri Indonesia ini.

balinese: Kenyel tiang nuturin, ngewelang suba apang tusing keto buin. Nanging, solah Adiné tileh kaketo. Kerasa tabahina sajan beliné, sing ké ia ngelah rasa hormat agigis ken Beli.
english: I was tired of telling and scolding him so he wouldn’t like that anymore. But what, his brother’s behavior is still like that. It feels like he’s not respected at his brother at alla, doesn't he have the slightest respect with his brother.
indonesian: Sudah capek saya memberitahukan, memarahi agar tidak seperti itu lagi. Tetapi apa, tingkah laku Adiknya masih seperti itu. Serasa tidak disegani sekali Kakaknya, tidakah ia punya rasa hormat sedikit pun dengan Kakaknya.

balinese: Aji, tabas ajebos kayuné punika, jagi anggen titiang ngarya kerajinan ring sekolah.
english: Daddy, please flatten that wood, I'll use it to make school ring crafts.
indonesian: Ayah, ratakanlah kayu itu, akan saya pakai untuk membuat kerajinan ring sekolah.

balinese: Ento punyan biyuné I Mémé tabasa aji arit ken I Bapa.
english: That mother's banana tree flattened using sickle by father.
indonesian: Pohon pisang ibu itu diratakanya menggunakan celurit oleh Bapak.

balinese: Tabasang lan getep-getep malu kayuné ento, nyanan lakar kaanggon saang ane tuh-tuh.
english: Flatten and cut the wood first, then dry-dry firewood will be used.
indonesian: Ratakan dan potong-potong dulu kayu itu, nanti akan dipakai kayu bakar yang kering-kering.

balinese: Tarune punika sampun tabasanga, sané mangkin rarisang ambil kayu jatiné punika.
english: The tree had been flattened, now please grab that teak wood.
indonesian: Pohon itu sudah diratakanya, sekarang silahkan ambil kayu jatinya itu.

balinese: Tabasin apang bersih kayuné énto, apang sing kanti natunin irage yen lakar majemak.
english: Flatten so that the wood is clean, so as not to hurt us when we take it.
indonesian: Ratakan agar kayu itu bersih, agar tidak melukai kita saat akan mengambilnya.

balinese: Kayuné énto suba tabasina teken Bapan tianga, jani tuah nganggoné apang dadi Bale.
english: The wood has been flattened by my father, now I just have to process it into a bed.
indonesian: Kayunya itu sudah diratakanya oleh bapak saya, sekarang tinggal mengolah agar menjadi sebuah ranjang.

balinese: Sanané ento tabeha aji tiing apang tusing enggalan elung.
english: That tool for carrying thing is reinforced with bamboo so it doesn't break quickly.
indonesian: Alat pemilkul itu diperkuatnya dengan bambu agar tidak cepat patah.

balinese: Isinin béngbéngan siapé tabeng aji duk apang ilid lan tusing palinga.
english: Attach the nesting chicken's nest with palm fiber cover, so it is hidden and not stolen.
indonesian: Isi sarang ayam bertelur itu dengan aling-aling berbahan ijuk, agar tersembunyi dan tidak dicuri.

balinese: Tabengin jebos motor bapané.
english: Please attach the protective cover on dad’s motorcycle
indonesian: Tolong pasangi pengaling pada motor ayah.

balinese: Kandang kuluk tiangé tabengina papan tekéning I Bapa.
english: My dog's cage was fitted with a board by the father.
indonesian: Kadang anjing saya dipasangi pengaling papan oleh Si ayah.

balinese: Sing ja cara makpak tabia apang perjani lalah.
english: It's not like eating chili which quickly feels the spicy.
indonesian: Tidak seperti memakan cabai yang dengan cepat merasakan pedasnya (peribahasa). (Suatu perbuatan tidak akan langsung menerima ganjarannya)

balinese: Mé…mé.. Mémé, tabianin ja bin bedik lawaré, jek sing merasa ape né!
english: Mom, mom ... Add the chili on ‘lawar’ a little, because it doesn't taste anything!
indonesian: Buk, Ibuk… Beri cabailah sedikit lawarnya, soalnya ini tidak berasa apa!

balinese: I Nyoman ngecat tabih satonden milu lomba makepung.
english: Nyoman painted the barred cikar wheels before joining the cow race.
indonesian: Si Nyoman mengecat roda cikar yang berjeruji sebelum mengikuti lomba karapan sapi.

balinese: Sandalne makutang di tabih punyan binginne dugas maplalianan ditu.
english: The sand was left at the base of the banyan tree's trunk while playing there.
indonesian: Sendalnya tertinggal di pangkal batang pohon beringin ketika bermain di sana.

balinese: Tabing umah tiange malakar aji kayu.
english: My house wall made from some wood.
indonesian: Dinding rumah saya berbahan kayu.

balinese: Tabingin balene ento apang tusing tampiasan.
english: attching the walls that building so that is not exposed the raindrops.
indonesian: Pasangi dinding bangunan itu agar tidak terkena percikan air hujan.

balinese: Umahne tusing tabingina yadiastun ia liu ngelah pipis.
english: The wall was not installed even though he had a lot of money.
indonesian: Rumahnya itu tidak dipasanginya dinding walaupun dia punya banyak uang.

balinese: Dini liu ada anak ane ngadep tabla.
english: Here there are lots of people who sell coffin.
indonesian: Di sini ada banyak orang yang menjual peti mati.

balinese: Cicing tiange tabrak montor dibi sanja. Aget ia tusing mati.
english: My Dog was hit by motorcycle yesterday. So luckily he didn't

balinese: I Nyoman Supada Artha (Panyarikan Pura Alus Arum, Desa Bangah, Baturiti, Tabanan): "Aji sane kamargiang nemonin rahina Pagerwesi puniki, inggihang aji tabuh rah." [Basa alus-singgih]

[Humble-high speech level] NB: In Desa Bangah at this particular temple (Pura Alus Arum) on this particular day (Pagerwesi), the tabuh rah does not occur in the usual series of three ritually-sanctioned cockfights. Instead, the tradition here is to have fighting cock by-proxies made of don jarak (castor bean leaves) fitted with bamboo spurs. These spurred leaves are tossed into a makeshift cockfighting ring just outside the temple grounds, and the fight is deemed sufficient when one (or both) of the leaves are torn by the opponent's spur.
indonesian: "Dengan yang akan diadakan pada hari Pagerwesi ini, diteruskan dengan tabuh rah."
